</span><span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Mapping CDA Patient Summary vers FHIR - Étape 4 finale</span>

<b>uses</b><span style="color: navy"> &quot;</span><a href="http://hl7.org/cda/stds/core/2.0.0-sd/StructureDefinition-HealthCareFacility.html" title="HealthCareFacility (CDA Class)">http://hl7.org/cda/stds/core/StructureDefinition/HealthCareFacility|2.0.0-sd</a><span style="color: navy">&quot; </span><b>alias </b>HealthCareFacility <b>as </b><b>source</b>
<b>uses</b><span style="color: navy"> &quot;</span><a href="http://hl7.org/fhir/R4/bundle.html" title="Bundle">http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Bundle|4.0.1</a><span style="color: navy">&quot; </span><b>alias </b>Bundle <b>as </b><b>target</b>
<b>uses</b><span style="color: navy"> &quot;</span><a href="http://hl7.org/fhir/R4/composition.html" title="Composition">http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Composition|4.0.1</a><span style="color: navy">&quot; </span><b>alias </b>Composition <b>as </b><b>target</b>
<b>uses</b><span style="color: navy"> &quot;</span><a href="http://hl7.org/fhir/R4/patient.html" title="Patient">http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Patient|4.0.1</a><span style="color: navy">&quot; </span><b>alias </b>Patient <b>as </b><b>target</b>
<b>uses</b><span style="color: navy"> &quot;</span><a href="http://hl7.org/fhir/R4/organization.html" title="Organization">http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Organization|4.0.1</a><span style="color: navy">&quot; </span><b>alias </b>Organization <b>as </b><b>target</b>
<b>uses</b><span style="color: navy"> &quot;</span><a href="http://hl7.org/fhir/R4/practitioner.html" title="Practitioner">http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Practitioner|4.0.1</a><span style="color: navy">&quot; </span><b>alias </b>Practitioner <b>as </b><b>target</b>
<b>uses</b><span style="color: navy"> &quot;</span><a href="http://hl7.org/fhir/R4/practitionerrole.html" title="PractitionerRole">http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/PractitionerRole|4.0.1</a><span style="color: navy">&quot; </span><b>alias </b>PractitionerRole <b>as </b><b>target</b>
<b>uses</b><span style="color: navy"> &quot;</span><a href="http://hl7.org/fhir/R4/relatedperson.html" title="RelatedPerson">http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/RelatedPerson|4.0.1</a><span style="color: navy">&quot; </span><b>alias </b>RelatedPerson <b>as </b><b>target</b>
<b>uses</b><span style="color: navy"> &quot;</span><a href="http://hl7.org/fhir/R4/encounter.html" title="Encounter">http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Encounter|4.0.1</a><span style="color: navy">&quot; </span><b>alias </b>Encounter <b>as </b><b>target</b>
<b>uses</b><span style="color: navy"> &quot;</span><a href="http://hl7.org/fhir/R4/location.html" title="Location">http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Location|4.0.1</a><span style="color: navy">&quot; </span><b>alias </b>Location <b>as </b><b>target</b>
<b>uses</b><span style="color: navy"> &quot;</span><a href="http://hl7.org/fhir/R4/condition.html" title="Condition">http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Condition|4.0.1</a><span style="color: navy">&quot; </span><b>alias </b>Condition <b>as </b><b>target</b>
<b>uses</b><span style="color: navy"> &quot;</span><a href="http://hl7.org/fhir/R4/allergyintolerance.html" title="AllergyIntolerance">http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/AllergyIntolerance|4.0.1</a><span style="color: navy">&quot; </span><b>alias </b>AllergyIntolerance <b>as </b><b>target</b>
<b>uses</b><span style="color: navy"> &quot;</span><a href="http://hl7.org/fhir/R4/adverseevent.html" title="AdverseEvent">http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/AdverseEvent|4.0.1</a><span style="color: navy">&quot; </span><b>alias </b>AdverseEvent <b>as </b><b>target</b>
<b>uses</b><span style="color: navy"> &quot;</span><a href="http://hl7.org/fhir/R4/medication.html" title="Medication">http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Medication|4.0.1</a><span style="color: navy">&quot; </span><b>alias </b>Medication <b>as </b><b>target</b>
<b>uses</b><span style="color: navy"> &quot;</span><a href="http://hl7.org/fhir/R4/medicationstatement.html" title="MedicationStatement">http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/MedicationStatement|4.0.1</a><span style="color: navy">&quot; </span><b>alias </b>MedicationStatement <b>as </b><b>target</b>
<b>uses</b><span style="color: navy"> &quot;</span><a href="http://hl7.org/fhir/R4/procedure.html" title="Procedure">http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Procedure|4.0.1</a><span style="color: navy">&quot; </span><b>alias </b>Procedure <b>as </b><b>target</b>
<b>uses</b><span style="color: navy"> &quot;</span><a href="http://hl7.org/fhir/R4/immunization.html" title="Immunization">http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Immunization|4.0.1</a><span style="color: navy">&quot; </span><b>alias </b>Immunization <b>as </b><b>target</b>
<b>uses</b><span style="color: navy"> &quot;</span><a href="http://hl7.org/fhir/R4/observation.html" title="Observation">http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Observation|4.0.1</a><span style="color: navy">&quot; </span><b>alias </b>Observation <b>as </b><b>target</b>
<b>uses</b><span style="color: navy"> &quot;</span><a href="http://hl7.org/fhir/R4/careplan.html" title="CarePlan">http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/CarePlan|4.0.1</a><span style="color: navy">&quot; </span><b>alias </b>CarePlan <b>as </b><b>target</b>
<b>uses</b><span style="color: navy"> &quot;</span><a href="http://hl7.org/fhir/R4/documentreference.html" title="DocumentReference">http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/DocumentReference|4.0.1</a><span style="color: navy">&quot; </span><b>alias </b>DocumentReference <b>as </b><b>target</b>
<b>uses</b><span style="color: navy"> &quot;</span><a href="http://hl7.org/fhir/R4/diagnosticreport.html" title="DiagnosticReport">http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/DiagnosticReport|4.0.1</a><span style="color: navy">&quot; </span><b>alias </b>DiagnosticReport <b>as </b><b>target</b>
<b>uses</b><span style="color: navy"> &quot;</span><a href="http://hl7.org/fhir/R4/medicationrequest.html" title="MedicationRequest">http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/MedicationRequest|4.0.1</a><span style="color: navy">&quot; </span><b>alias </b>MedicationRequest <b>as </b><b>target</b>
<b>uses</b><span style="color: navy"> &quot;</span><a href="http://hl7.org/fhir/R4/servicerequest.html" title="ServiceRequest">http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/ServiceRequest|4.0.1</a><span style="color: navy">&quot; </span><b>alias </b>ServiceRequest <b>as </b><b>target</b>
<b>uses</b><span style="color: navy"> &quot;</span><a href="http://hl7.org/fhir/R4/immunizationrecommendation.html" title="ImmunizationRecommendation">http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/ImmunizationRecommendation|4.0.1</a><span style="color: navy">&quot; </span><b>alias </b>ImmunizationRecommendation <b>as </b><b>target</b>
<b>uses</b><span style="color: navy"> &quot;</span><a href="http://hl7.org/fhir/R4/familymemberhistory.html" title="FamilyMemberHistory">http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/FamilyMemberHistory|4.0.1</a><span style="color: navy">&quot; </span><b>alias </b>FamilyMemberHistory <b>as </b><b>target</b>
<b>uses</b><span style="color: navy"> &quot;</span><a href="http://hl7.org/fhir/R4/datatypes.html#Identifier" title="Identifier">http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Identifier|4.0.1</a><span style="color: navy">&quot; </span><b>alias </b>Identifier <b>as </b><b>target</b>
<b>uses</b><span style="color: navy"> &quot;</span><a href="http://hl7.org/fhir/R4/datatypes.html#CodeableConcept" title="CodeableConcept">http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/CodeableConcept|4.0.1</a><span style="color: navy">&quot; </span><b>alias </b>CodeableConcept <b>as </b><b>target</b>
<b>uses</b><span style="color: navy"> &quot;</span><a href="http://hl7.org/fhir/R4/datatypes.html#Coding" title="Coding">http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Coding|4.0.1</a><span style="color: navy">&quot; </span><b>alias </b>Coding <b>as </b><b>target</b>
<b>uses</b><span style="color: navy"> &quot;</span><a href="http://hl7.org/fhir/R4/references.html#Reference" title="Reference">http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Reference|4.0.1</a><span style="color: navy">&quot; </span><b>alias </b>Reference <b>as </b><b>target</b>
<b>uses</b><span style="color: navy"> &quot;</span><a href="http://hl7.org/fhir/R4/datatypes.html#Period" title="Period">http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Period|4.0.1</a><span style="color: navy">&quot; </span><b>alias </b>Period <b>as </b><b>target</b>
<b>uses</b><span style="color: navy"> &quot;</span><a href="http://hl7.org/fhir/R4/datatypes.html#Attachment" title="Attachment">http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Attachment|4.0.1</a><span style="color: navy">&quot; </span><b>alias </b>Attachment <b>as </b><b>target</b>
<b>uses</b><span style="color: navy"> &quot;</span><a href="http://hl7.org/fhir/R4/datatypes.html#Narrative" title="Narrative">http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Narrative|4.0.1</a><span style="color: navy">&quot; </span><b>alias </b>Narrative <b>as </b><b>target</b>
<b>uses</b><span style="color: navy"> &quot;</span><a href="http://hl7.org/fhir/R4/datatypes.html#Timing" title="Timing">http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Timing|4.0.1</a><span style="color: navy">&quot; </span><b>alias </b>Timing <b>as </b><b>target</b>
<b>uses</b><span style="color: navy"> &quot;</span><a href="http://hl7.org/fhir/R4/datatypes.html#Range" title="Range">http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Range|4.0.1</a><span style="color: navy">&quot; </span><b>alias </b>Range <b>as </b><b>target</b>
<b>uses</b><span style="color: navy"> &quot;</span><a href="http://hl7.org/fhir/R4/datatypes.html#Quantity" title="Quantity">http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Quantity|4.0.1</a><span style="color: navy">&quot; </span><b>alias </b>Quantity <b>as </b><b>target</b>
<b>uses</b><span style="color: navy"> &quot;</span><a href="http://hl7.org/fhir/R4/datatypes.html#Ratio" title="Ratio">http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Ratio|4.0.1</a><span style="color: navy">&quot; </span><b>alias </b>Ratio <b>as </b><b>target</b>
<b>uses</b><span style="color: navy"> &quot;</span><a href="http://hl7.org/fhir/R4/datatypes.html#Annotation" title="Annotation">http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Annotation|4.0.1</a><span style="color: navy">&quot; </span><b>alias </b>Annotation <b>as </b><b>target</b>
<b>uses</b><span style="color: navy"> &quot;</span><a href="http://hl7.org/fhir/R4/datatypes.html#code" title="code">http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/code|4.0.1</a><span style="color: navy">&quot; </span><b>alias </b>code <b>as </b><b>target</b>
<b>uses</b><span style="color: navy"> &quot;</span><a href="http://hl7.org/fhir/R4/datatypes.html#date" title="date">http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/date|4.0.1</a><span style="color: navy">&quot; </span><b>alias </b>date <b>as </b><b>target</b>
<b>uses</b><span style="color: navy"> &quot;</span><a href="http://hl7.org/fhir/R4/datatypes.html#dateTime" title="dateTime">http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/dateTime|4.0.1</a><span style="color: navy">&quot; </span><b>alias </b>dateTime <b>as </b><b>target</b>
<b>uses</b><span style="color: navy"> &quot;</span><a href="http://hl7.org/fhir/R4/datatypes.html#boolean" title="boolean">http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/boolean|4.0.1</a><span style="color: navy">&quot; </span><b>alias </b>boolean <b>as </b><b>target</b>

<b>imports</b><span style="color: navy"> &quot;</span><a href="StructureMap-CdaToFHIRTypes.html" title="Mapping de CDA vers les FHIR Types (A partir des sources de Oliver Egger)">https://interop.esante.gouv.fr/ig/fhir/mappingcdafhir/StructureMap/CdaToFHIRTypes|0.1.0</a><span style="color: navy">&quot;
</span><b>imports</b><span style="color: navy"> &quot;</span><a href="StructureMap-CdaToBundle.html" title="Mapping CDA vers FHIR - Étape 2 socle générique orienté CDA">https://interop.esante.gouv.fr/ig/fhir/mappingcdafhir/StructureMap/CdaToBundle</a><span style="color: navy">&quot;
</span><b>imports</b><span style="color: navy"> &quot;</span><a href="StructureMap-CdaFrToBundle.html" title="Mapping CDA-FR vers FHIR - Socle enrichi français">https://interop.esante.gouv.fr/ig/fhir/mappingcdafhir/StructureMap/CdaFrToBundle|0.1.0</a><span style="color: navy">&quot;
</span>
<span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">GROUPE D’ENTRÉE — CRÉATION DU BUNDLE FINAL PATIENT SUMMARY</span>

<span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">   Ce groupe crée le Bundle final avec Composition et Patient. Ces ressources</span>
<span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">   sont toujours nécessaires dans un document FHIR de type document.</span>

<span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">   Les autres ressources administratives sont créées plus loin, uniquement si le</span>
<span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">   bloc CDA correspondant existe</span>
<b>group </b>TransformPatientSummaryClinicalDocumentToFHIRDocument<span style="color: navy">(</span><b>source</b> <span style="color: maroon">cda</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>ClinicalDocument, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">bundle</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>Bundle<span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>  cda<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span> bundle.entry<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">compositionEntry</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> compositionEntry.resource = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Composition'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">composition</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> composition.id = <b>uuid</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> compositionEntry.fullUrl = <span style="color: navy">(</span>'urn:uuid:' + %composition.id<span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> bundle.entry<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">patientEntry</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> patientEntry.resource = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Patient'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">patient</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> patient.id = <b>uuid</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> patientEntry.fullUrl = <span style="color: navy">(</span>'urn:uuid:' + %patient.id<span style="color: navy">)</span><b> then </b>OrchestrateClinicalDocumentFinalTransformation<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">cda</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">patient</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">composition</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">bundle</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;main&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
<span style="color: navy">}

</span><span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">GROUPE D’ORCHESTRATION FINALE — SOCLE FRANÇAIS + MÉTIER PATIENT SUMMARY</span>
<span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">   Ce groupe applique deux traitements successifs :</span>
<span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">   - MapClinicalDocumentHeaderWithFrenchRules, importé depuis l’étape 3, traite</span>
<span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">     l’en-tête CDA, crée les ressources administratives nécessaires, applique le</span>
<span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">     socle générique de l’étape 2 et l’enrichissement français ;</span>
<span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">   - MapPatientSummaryBody traite ensuite les sections Patient Summary et crée</span>
<span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">     les ressources métier à partir des entries CDA.</span>

<span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">   Les ressources optionnelles ne sont donc pas créées au début : elles sont</span>
<span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">   créées uniquement dans les groupes associés aux blocs CDA présents</span>
<b>group </b>OrchestrateClinicalDocumentFinalTransformation<span style="color: navy">(</span><b>source</b> <span style="color: maroon">cda</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>ClinicalDocument, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">patient</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>Patient, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">composition</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>Composition, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">bundle</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>Bundle<span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">CDA ClinicalDocument.header -&gt; socle générique + enrichissement français + création interne des ressources administratives</span>
  cda<b> then </b>MapClinicalDocumentHeaderWithFrenchRules<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">cda</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">bundle</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">composition</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">patient</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;headerFrenchBase&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">CDA structuredBody Patient Summary -&gt; FHIR Composition.section + entries métier</span>
  cda<b> then </b>MapPatientSummaryBody<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">cda</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">composition</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">bundle</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">patient</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;patientSummaryBody&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
<span style="color: navy">}

</span><span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">CORPS PATIENT SUMMARY — SECTIONS + ENTRIES MÉTIER</span>
<span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">   Pour chaque section CDA :</span>
<span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">   - MapCDASectionToCompositionSection, importé depuis l’étape 2, crée le</span>
<span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">     squelette commun de la Composition.section avec title, code et text ;</span>
<span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">   - MapPatientSummarySectionEntries crée ensuite les ressources métier selon</span>
<span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">     le code LOINC de la section</span>
<b>group </b>MapPatientSummaryBody<span style="color: navy">(</span><b>source</b> <span style="color: maroon">src</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>ClinicalDocument, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">composition</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>Composition, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">bundle</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>Bundle, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">patient</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>Patient<span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>  src.component<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">cdaComponent</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    cdaComponent.structuredBody<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">structuredBody</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      structuredBody.component<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">bodyComponent</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>        bodyComponent.section<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">section</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>composition.section<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">compSection</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>          <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">CDA section.title/code/text -&gt; FHIR Composition.section</span>
          section<b> then </b>MapCDASectionToCompositionSection<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">section</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">compSection</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;sectionBase&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
          <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">CDA section.entry -&gt; FHIR ressources métier Patient Summary</span>
          section<b> then </b>MapPatientSummarySectionEntries<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">section</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">compSection</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">bundle</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">patient</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;patientSummaryEntries&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
        <span style="color: navy">}</span><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;bodyComponent&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span><span style="color: navy">;</span>
<span style="color: navy">}

</span><span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">DISPATCH DES ENTRIES MÉTIER PATIENT SUMMARY</span>
<span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">   CDA section.code LOINC -&gt; groupe métier FHIR correspondant</span>
<b>group </b>MapPatientSummarySectionEntries<span style="color: navy">(</span><b>source</b> <span style="color: maroon">section</span>, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">compSection</span>, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">bundle</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>Bundle, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">patient</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>Patient<span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">CDA section Problèmes actifs -&gt; FHIR Condition</span>
  section.code<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">secCode</span><b> where </b>secCode.code = '11450-4'<b> then </b>PatientSummaryConditionSection<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">section</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">compSection</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">bundle</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">patient</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;activeProblems&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">CDA section Antécédents médicaux -&gt; FHIR Condition</span>
  section.code<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">secCode</span><b> where </b>secCode.code = '11348-0'<b> then </b>PatientSummaryConditionSection<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">section</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">compSection</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">bundle</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">patient</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;medicalHistory&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">CDA section Allergies / hypersensibilités -&gt; FHIR AllergyIntolerance</span>
  section.code<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">secCode</span><b> where </b>secCode.code = '48765-2'<b> then </b>PatientSummaryAllergySection<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">section</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">compSection</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">bundle</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">patient</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;allergies&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">CDA section Traitements -&gt; FHIR MedicationStatement</span>
  section.code<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">secCode</span><b> where </b>secCode.code = '10160-0'<b> then </b>PatientSummaryMedicationSection<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">section</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">compSection</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">bundle</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">patient</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;medications&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">CDA section Historique des actes -&gt; FHIR Procedure</span>
  section.code<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">secCode</span><b> where </b>secCode.code = '47519-4'<b> then </b>PatientSummaryProcedureSection<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">section</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">compSection</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">bundle</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">patient</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;procedureHistory&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Effets indésirables médicamenteux -&gt; AdverseEvent + MedicationStatement + Condition.</span>
  section.code<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">secCode</span><b> where </b>secCode.code = '44939-7'<b> then </b>PatientSummaryAdverseDrugReactionSection<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">section</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">compSection</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">bundle</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">patient</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;adverseDrugReactions&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">CDA section Vaccinations -&gt; FHIR Immunization</span>
  section.code<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">secCode</span><b> where </b>secCode.code = '11369-6'<b> then </b>PatientSummaryImmunizationSection<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">section</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">compSection</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">bundle</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">patient</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;immunizations&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">CDA section Statut fonctionnel -&gt; FHIR Observation</span>
  section.code<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">secCode</span><b> where </b>secCode.code = '47420-5'<b> then </b>PatientSummaryFunctionalStatusSection<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">section</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">compSection</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">bundle</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">patient</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;functionalStatus&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">CDA section Constantes -&gt; FHIR Observation</span>
  section.code<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">secCode</span><b> where </b>secCode.code = '8716-3'<b> then </b>PatientSummaryVitalSignsSection<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">section</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">compSection</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">bundle</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">patient</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;vitalSigns&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">CDA section Mode de vie -&gt; FHIR Observation</span>
  section.code<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">secCode</span><b> where </b>secCode.code = '29762-2'<b> then </b>PatientSummaryLifestyleSection<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">section</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">compSection</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">bundle</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">patient</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;lifestyle&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Facteurs de risques professionnels -&gt; Observation si entrée structurée, sinon narratif seul.</span>
  section.code<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">secCode</span><b> where </b>secCode.code = '10161-8'<b> then </b>PatientSummaryProfessionalRisksSection<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">section</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">compSection</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">bundle</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">patient</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;professionalRisks&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">CDA section Résultats -&gt; FHIR Observation</span>
  section.code<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">secCode</span><b> where </b>secCode.code = '30954-2'<b> then </b>PatientSummaryResultsSection<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">section</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">compSection</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">bundle</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">patient</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;results&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">CDA section Plan de soins -&gt; FHIR CarePlan</span>
  section.code<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">secCode</span><b> where </b>secCode.code = '18776-5'<b> then </b>PatientSummaryCarePlanSection<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">section</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">compSection</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">bundle</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">patient</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;carePlan&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">CDA section Antécédents familiaux -&gt; FHIR FamilyMemberHistory</span>
  section.code<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">secCode</span><b> where </b>secCode.code = '10157-6'<b> then </b>PatientSummaryFamilyHistorySection<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">section</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">compSection</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">bundle</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">patient</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;familyHistory&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
<span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Dispositifs médicaux : section conservée en narratif uniquement pour l’instant.</span>
<span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Le mapping structuré sera traité plus tard avec Device / DeviceUseStatement.</span>
<span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Points de vigilance : section conservée en narratif uniquement pour l’instant.</span>
<span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Le mapping structuré sera traité plus tard avec Flag, DetectedIssue ou Observation selon le contenu.</span>
<span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Directives anticipées : section conservée en narratif uniquement pour l’instant.</span>
<span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Le mapping structuré sera traité plus tard avec Consent, Observation ou DocumentReference selon le contenu.</span>
<span style="color: navy">}

</span><span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">1. PROBLÈMES ACTIFS ET ANTÉCÉDENTS MÉDICAUX</span>
<span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Section CDA problèmes / antécédents -&gt; Conditions FHIR</span>
<b>group </b>PatientSummaryConditionSection<span style="color: navy">(</span><b>source</b> <span style="color: maroon">section</span>, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">compSection</span>, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">bundle</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>Bundle, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">patient</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>Patient<span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Entrées CDA -&gt; observations de problèmes -&gt; Condition.</span>
  section.entry<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">entry</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    entry.act<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">problemConcernAct</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      problemConcernAct.entryRelationship<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">er</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>        er.observation<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">problemObservation</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span> bundle.entry<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">conditionEntry</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> conditionEntry.resource = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Condition'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">condition</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> condition.id = <b>uuid</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> conditionEntry.fullUrl = <span style="color: navy">(</span>'urn:uuid:' + %condition.id<span style="color: navy">)</span><b> then </b>PatientSummaryConditionFromProblemObservation<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">problemObservation</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">condition</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">compSection</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">patient</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">bundle</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;conditionFromProblemObservation&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;problemEntryRelationship&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;problemConcernAct&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;sectionEntry&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
<span style="color: navy">}

</span><span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Observation CDA de problème -&gt; Condition FHIR</span>
<b>group </b>PatientSummaryConditionFromProblemObservation<span style="color: navy">(</span><b>source</b> <span style="color: maroon">observation</span>, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">condition</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>Condition, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">compSection</span>, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">patient</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>Patient, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">bundle</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>Bundle<span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Patient concerné.</span>
  observation<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span> condition.subject = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Reference'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">subjectRef</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> subjectRef.reference = <span style="color: navy">(</span>'urn:uuid:' + %patient.id<span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;subject&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Identifiant du problème.</span>
  observation.id<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">problemId</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>condition.identifier = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Identifier'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">identifier</span><b> then </b>II<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">problemId</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">identifier</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;identifier&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Catégorie / type du problème.</span>
  observation.code<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">problemType</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>condition.category = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'CodeableConcept'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">category</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    problemType<b> then </b>CDCodeableConcept<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">problemType</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">category</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;categoryCoding&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    observation.text<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">txt</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      txt.reference<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">ref</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>        ref.value<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">value</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>category.text = <b>cast</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">value</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: blue">'string'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;categoryText&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      <span style="color: navy">}</span><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;category&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Problème médical.</span>
  observation.value<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">problemValue</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>condition.code = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'CodeableConcept'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">code</span><b> then </b>CDCodeableConcept<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">problemValue</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">code</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;code&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Dates de début et de fin.</span>
  observation.effectiveTime<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">effectiveTime</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    effectiveTime.low<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">low</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>condition.onset = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'dateTime'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">onsetDateTime</span><b> then </b>TSDateTime<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">low</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">onsetDateTime</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;onsetDateTime&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    effectiveTime.high<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">high</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>condition.abatement = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'dateTime'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">abatementDateTime</span><b> then </b>TSDateTime<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">high</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">abatementDateTime</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;abatementDateTime&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Sous-observations : sévérité, statut, stade et certitude.</span>
  observation.entryRelationship<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">er</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Sévérité -&gt; Condition.severity.</span>
    er.observation<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">severityObs</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      severityObs.templateId<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">tid</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>        tid.root<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">root</span><b> where </b>root = '1.2.250.1.213.1.1.3.29'<b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>          severityObs.value<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">severityValue</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>condition.severity = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'CodeableConcept'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">severity</span><b> then </b>CDCodeableConcept<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">severityValue</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">severity</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;severity&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
        <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;severity&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;severityTemplate&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;severityBlock&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Statut du problème -&gt; Condition.clinicalStatus.</span>
    er.observation<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">problemStatusObs</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      problemStatusObs.templateId<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">tid</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>        tid.root<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">root</span><b> where </b>root = '1.2.250.1.213.1.1.3.30'<b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {

</span>            statusValue.displayName<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">display</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>clinicalStatus.text = <b>cast</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">display</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: blue">'string'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;clinicalStatusText&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
            statusValue.code<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">code</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>clinicalStatus.coding = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Coding'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">coding</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {

              code<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>coding.code = <b>cast</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">code</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: blue">'code'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;clinicalStatusCode&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>

              code<b> where </b>code = 'recurrence'<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>coding.display = <span style="color: blue">'Recurrence'</span> <i>&quot;clinicalStatusDisplayRecurrence&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>

              code<b> where </b>code = 'remission'<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>coding.display = <span style="color: blue">'Remission'</span> <i>&quot;clinicalStatusDisplayRemission&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
              code<b> where </b>code = 'resolved'<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>coding.display = <span style="color: blue">'Resolved'</span> <i>&quot;clinicalStatusDisplayResolved&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
            <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;clinicalStatusCoding&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
          <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;clinicalStatus&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
        <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;clinicalStatus&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;clinicalStatusTemplate&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;clinicalStatusBlock&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">État / stade clinique -&gt; Condition.stage.summary.</span>
    er.observation<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">healthStatusObs</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      healthStatusObs.templateId<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">tid</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>        tid.root<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">root</span><b> where </b>root = '1.2.250.1.213.1.1.3.31'<b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>          healthStatusObs.value<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">healthStatusValue</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>condition.stage<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">stage</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>            healthStatusValue<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>stage.summary = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'CodeableConcept'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">summary</span><b> then </b>CDCodeableConcept<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">healthStatusValue</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">summary</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;stageSummary&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
          <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;stage&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
        <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;stageSummary&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;stageSummaryTemplate&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;stageSummaryBlock&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Certitude -&gt; Condition.verificationStatus.</span>
    er.observation<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">certaintyObs</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      certaintyObs.templateId<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">tid</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>        tid.root<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">root</span><b> where </b>root = '1.2.250.1.213.1.1.3.171'<b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>          certaintyObs.value<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">certaintyValue</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>condition.verificationStatus = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'CodeableConcept'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">verificationStatus</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>            certaintyValue.displayName<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">display</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>verificationStatus.text = <b>cast</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">display</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: blue">'string'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;verificationStatusText&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
            certaintyValue.code<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">code</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>verificationStatus.coding = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Coding'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">coding</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>              certaintyValue<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>coding.system = <span style="color: blue">'http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/condition-ver-status'</span> <i>&quot;verificationStatusSystem&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
              code<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>coding.code = <b>cast</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">code</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: blue">'code'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;verificationStatusCode&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
              code<b> where </b>code = 'unconfirmed'<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>coding.display = <span style="color: blue">'Unconfirmed'</span> <i>&quot;verificationStatusDisplayUnconfirmed&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
              code<b> where </b>code = 'provisional'<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>coding.display = <span style="color: blue">'Provisional'</span> <i>&quot;verificationStatusDisplayProvisional&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
              code<b> where </b>code = 'differential'<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>coding.display = <span style="color: blue">'Differential'</span> <i>&quot;verificationStatusDisplayDifferential&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
              code<b> where </b>code = 'confirmed'<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>coding.display = <span style="color: blue">'Confirmed'</span> <i>&quot;verificationStatusDisplayConfirmed&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
              code<b> where </b>code = 'refuted'<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>coding.display = <span style="color: blue">'Refuted'</span> <i>&quot;verificationStatusDisplayRefuted&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
              code<b> where </b>code = 'entered-in-error'<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>coding.display = <span style="color: blue">'Entered in Error'</span> <i>&quot;verificationStatusDisplayEnteredInError&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
            <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;verificationStatusCoding&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
          <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;verificationStatus&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
        <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;verificationStatus&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;verificationStatusTemplate&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;verificationStatusBlock&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;entryRelationships&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Document externe lié au problème -&gt; DocumentReference + evidence.</span>
  observation.reference<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">cdaReference</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    cdaReference.externalDocument<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">externalDocument</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span> bundle.entry<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">documentReferenceEntry</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> documentReferenceEntry.resource = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'DocumentReference'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">documentReference</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> documentReference.id = <b>uuid</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> documentReferenceEntry.fullUrl = <span style="color: navy">(</span>'urn:uuid:' + %documentReference.id<span style="color: navy">)</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      externalDocument<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>documentReference.status = <span style="color: blue">'current'</span> <i>&quot;documentReferenceStatus&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      externalDocument<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span> documentReference.subject = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Reference'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">subjectRef</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> subjectRef.reference = <span style="color: navy">(</span>'urn:uuid:' + %patient.id<span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;documentReferenceSubject&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      externalDocument.id<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">externalId</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>documentReference.identifier = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Identifier'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">identifier</span><b> then </b>II<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">externalId</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">identifier</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;documentReferenceIdentifier&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      externalDocument.text<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">externalText</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>        externalText.reference<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">externalRef</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>          externalRef.value<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">url</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>documentReference.content<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">content</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>            url<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>content.attachment = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Attachment'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">attachment</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>              url<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>attachment.url = <b>cast</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">url</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: blue">'string'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;attachmentUrl&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
            <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;attachment&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
          <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;content&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
        <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;externalTextReference&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;externalText&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      externalDocument<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>condition.evidence<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">evidence</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>        externalDocument<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span> evidence.detail = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Reference'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">detailRef</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> detailRef.reference = <span style="color: navy">(</span>'urn:uuid:' + %documentReference.id<span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;evidenceDetail&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;evidence&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;externalDocumentReference&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;externalReference&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Référence de la Condition dans la Composition.section.</span>
  observation<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span> compSection.entry = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Reference'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">sectionRef</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> sectionRef.reference = <span style="color: navy">(</span>'urn:uuid:' + %condition.id<span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;sectionEntry&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
<span style="color: navy">}

</span><span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">2. ALLERGIES / HYPERSENSIBILITÉS</span>
<span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Section CDA allergies / hypersensibilités -&gt; AllergyIntolerance</span>
<b>group </b>PatientSummaryAllergySection<span style="color: navy">(</span><b>source</b> <span style="color: maroon">section</span>, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">compSection</span>, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">bundle</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>Bundle, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">patient</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>Patient<span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Section allergies.</span>
  section.templateId<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">sectionTid</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    sectionTid.root<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">sectionRoot</span><b> where </b>sectionRoot = '1.2.250.1.213.1.1.2.137'<b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      section.entry<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">entry</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>        entry.act<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">allergyConcernAct</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>          allergyConcernAct.templateId<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">actTid</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>            actTid.root<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">actRoot</span><b> where </b>actRoot = '1.2.250.1.213.1.1.3.40'<b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>              allergyConcernAct.entryRelationship<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">er</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>                er.observation<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">allergyObservation</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>                  allergyObservation.templateId<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">obsTid</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>                    obsTid.root<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">obsRoot</span><b> where </b>obsRoot = '1.2.250.1.213.1.1.3.41'<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span> bundle.entry<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">allergyEntry</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> allergyEntry.resource = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'AllergyIntolerance'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">allergy</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> allergy.id = <b>uuid</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> allergyEntry.fullUrl = <span style="color: navy">(</span>'urn:uuid:' + %allergy.id<span style="color: navy">)</span><b> then </b>AllergyFromCdaObservation<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">allergyObservation</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">allergy</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">compSection</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">patient</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;allergyFromCdaObservation&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
                  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;allergyObservationTemplate&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
                <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;allergyObservation&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
              <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;allergyEntryRelationship&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
            <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;frAllergyConcernAct&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
          <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;allergyConcernActTemplate&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
        <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;allergyConcernAct&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;sectionEntry&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;frAllergySection&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;sectionTemplate&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
<span style="color: navy">}

</span><span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Observation CDA d’allergie -&gt; AllergyIntolerance</span>
<b>group </b>AllergyFromCdaObservation<span style="color: navy">(</span><b>source</b> <span style="color: maroon">observation</span>, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">allergy</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>AllergyIntolerance, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">compSection</span>, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">patient</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>Patient<span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Identifiant et patient.</span>
  observation.id<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">allergyId</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>allergy.identifier = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Identifier'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">identifier</span><b> then </b>II<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">allergyId</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">identifier</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;identifier&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  observation<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span> allergy.patient = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Reference'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">patientRef</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> patientRef.reference = <span style="color: navy">(</span>'urn:uuid:' + %patient.id<span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;patient&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Agent responsable.</span>
  observation.participant<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">participant</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    participant.participantRole<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">participantRole</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      participantRole.playingEntity<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">playingEntity</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>        playingEntity.code<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">allergenCode</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>allergy.code = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'CodeableConcept'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">code</span><b> then </b>CDCodeableConcept<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">allergenCode</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">code</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;allergenCode&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      <span style="color: navy">}</span><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Type et catégorie.</span>

            certaintyValue.displayName<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">display</span><b> where </b>certaintyValue.code.empty() and (display.lower().contains('erreur') or display.lower().contains('saisi par erreur'))<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>verificationStatus.coding = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Coding'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">coding</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {

    er.observation<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">reactionObs</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {

</span>                  severityObs.value<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">severityValue</span><b> where </b>severityValue.code = '255604002'<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>reaction.severity = <span style="color: blue">'mild'</span> <i>&quot;severityMild&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>

</span><span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">3. PROCÉDURES / ACTES</span>

</span>  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Section actes / procédures.</span>

</span>    sectionTid.root<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">sectionRoot</span><b> where </b>sectionRoot = '1.2.250.1.213.1.1.2.136'<b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {

</span>            procTid.root<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">procRoot</span><b> where </b>procRoot = '1.2.250.1.213.1.1.3.62'<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span> bundle.entry<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">procedureEntry</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> procedureEntry.resource = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Procedure'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">fhirProcedure</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> fhirProcedure.id = <b>uuid</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> procedureEntry.fullUrl = <span style="color: navy">(</span>'urn:uuid:' + %fhirProcedure.id<span style="color: navy">)</span><b> then </b>PatientSummaryProcedureFromProcedure<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">cdaProcedure</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">fhirProcedure</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">compSection</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">patient</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">bundle</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;procedure&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
