</span><span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Acte CDA -&gt; Procedure FHIR</span>
<b>group </b>PatientSummaryProcedureFromProcedure<span style="color: navy">(</span><b>source</b> <span style="color: maroon">procedure</span>, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">fhirProcedure</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>Procedure, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">compSection</span>, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">patient</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>Patient, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">bundle</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>Bundle<span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Statut.</span>
  procedure<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>fhirProcedure.status = <span style="color: blue">'unknown'</span> <i>&quot;statusDefault&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  procedure.statusCode<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">statusCode</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    statusCode.code<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">code</span><b> where </b>code = 'completed'<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>fhirProcedure.status = <span style="color: blue">'completed'</span> <i>&quot;completed&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    statusCode.code<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">code</span><b> where </b>code = 'active'<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>fhirProcedure.status = <span style="color: blue">'in-progress'</span> <i>&quot;active&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    statusCode.code<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">code</span><b> where </b>code = 'aborted'<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>fhirProcedure.status = <span style="color: blue">'stopped'</span> <i>&quot;aborted&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    statusCode.code<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">code</span><b> where </b>code = 'cancelled'<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>fhirProcedure.status = <span style="color: blue">'not-done'</span> <i>&quot;cancelled&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    statusCode.code<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">code</span><b> where </b>code = 'suspended'<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>fhirProcedure.status = <span style="color: blue">'on-hold'</span> <i>&quot;suspended&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;status&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  procedure.moodCode<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">mood</span><b> where </b>mood = 'INT'<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>fhirProcedure.status = <span style="color: blue">'preparation'</span> <i>&quot;statusIntent&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Identifiant, patient et code de l’acte.</span>
  procedure.id<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">procedureId</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>fhirProcedure.identifier = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Identifier'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">identifier</span><b> then </b>II<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">procedureId</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">identifier</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;identifier&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  procedure<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span> fhirProcedure.subject = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Reference'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">subjectRef</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> subjectRef.reference = <span style="color: navy">(</span>'urn:uuid:' + %patient.id<span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;subject&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  procedure.code<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">procedureCode</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>fhirProcedure.code = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'CodeableConcept'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">code</span><b> then </b>CDCodeableConcept<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">procedureCode</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">code</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Date ou période de réalisation.</span>
  procedure.effectiveTime<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">effectiveTime</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    effectiveTime.value<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">value</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>fhirProcedure.performed = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'dateTime'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">performedDateTime</span><b> then </b>TSDateTime<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">effectiveTime</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">performedDateTime</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;performedDateTime&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    effectiveTime.low<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">low</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>fhirProcedure.performed = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Period'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">performedPeriod</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      low<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>performedPeriod.start = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'dateTime'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">start</span><b> then </b>TSDateTime<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">low</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">start</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;start&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      effectiveTime.high<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">high</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>performedPeriod.end = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'dateTime'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">end</span><b> then </b>TSDateTime<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">high</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">end</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;end&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;performedPeriod&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;performed&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Site anatomique.</span>
  procedure.targetSiteCode<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">targetSiteCode</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>fhirProcedure.bodySite = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'CodeableConcept'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">bodySite</span><b> then </b>CDCodeableConcept<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">targetSiteCode</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">bodySite</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;targetSite&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  procedure.approachSiteCode<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">approachSiteCode</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>fhirProcedure.bodySite = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'CodeableConcept'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">approachSite</span><b> then </b>CDCodeableConcept<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">approachSiteCode</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">approachSite</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;approachSite&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Auteur et exécutant.</span>
  procedure.author<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">author</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    author.assignedAuthor<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">assignedAuthor</span><b> then </b>ProcedureRecorderFromAssignedAuthor<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">assignedAuthor</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">fhirProcedure</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">bundle</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;recorder&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  procedure.performer<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">performer</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    performer.assignedEntity<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">assignedEntity</span><b> then </b>ProcedurePerformerFromAssignedEntity<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">assignedEntity</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">fhirProcedure</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">bundle</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;performer&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Informations complémentaires.</span>
  procedure.entryRelationship<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">er</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Motif de l’acte.</span>
    er.act<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">reasonAct</span><b> where </b>er.typeCode = 'RSON'<b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      reasonAct.templateId<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">tid</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>        tid.root<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">root</span><b> where </b>root = '1.2.250.1.213.1.1.3.36'<b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>          reasonAct.code<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">reasonCode</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>fhirProcedure.reasonCode = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'CodeableConcept'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">reason</span><b> then </b>CDCodeableConcept<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">reasonCode</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">reason</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;reasonCode&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
        <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;reason&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;reasonTemplate&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;reasonAct&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Commentaire non mappé pour l’instant.</span>
    er.act<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">commentAct</span><b> where </b>er.typeCode = 'SUBJ'<b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      commentAct.templateId<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">tid</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>        tid.root<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">root</span><b> where </b>root = '1.2.250.1.213.1.1.3.32' <i>&quot;commentNotMapped&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;commentTemplate&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;commentAct&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Dispositif médical utilisé.</span>
    er.act<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">deviceReferenceAct</span><b> where </b>er.typeCode = 'REFR'<b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      deviceReferenceAct.templateId<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">tid</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>        tid.root<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">root</span><b> where </b>root = '1.2.250.1.213.1.1.3.36'<b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>          deviceReferenceAct.id<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">deviceId</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span> fhirProcedure.usedReference = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Reference'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">usedRef</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> usedRef.identifier = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Identifier'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">identifier</span><b> then </b>II<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">deviceId</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">identifier</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;usedReference&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
        <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;deviceReference&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;deviceReferenceTemplate&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;deviceReferenceAct&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Observation liée à l’acte.</span>
    er.observation<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">linkedObservation</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      linkedObservation.templateId<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">tid</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>        tid.root<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">root</span><b> where </b>root = '1.2.250.1.213.1.1.3.48'<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span> bundle.entry<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">obsEntry</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> obsEntry.resource = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Observation'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">observation</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> observation.id = <b>uuid</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> obsEntry.fullUrl = <span style="color: navy">(</span>'urn:uuid:' + %observation.id<span style="color: navy">)</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>          linkedObservation<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>observation.status = <span style="color: blue">'final'</span> <i>&quot;observationStatus&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
          linkedObservation.id<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">id</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>observation.identifier = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Identifier'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">identifier</span><b> then </b>II<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">id</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">identifier</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;observationIdentifier&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
          linkedObservation<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span> observation.subject = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Reference'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">subjectRef</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> subjectRef.reference = <span style="color: navy">(</span>'urn:uuid:' + %patient.id<span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;observationSubject&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
          linkedObservation<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>observation.category = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'CodeableConcept'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">category</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>            linkedObservation<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>category.coding = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Coding'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">coding</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>              linkedObservation<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>coding.system = <span style="color: blue">'http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/observation-category'</span> <i>&quot;categorySystem&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
              linkedObservation<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>coding.code = <span style="color: blue">'procedure'</span> <i>&quot;categoryCode&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
              linkedObservation<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>coding.display = <span style="color: blue">'Procedure'</span> <i>&quot;categoryDisplay&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
            <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;categoryCoding&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
          <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;category&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
          linkedObservation.code<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">code</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>observation.code = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'CodeableConcept'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">cc</span><b> then </b>CDCodeableConcept<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">code</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">cc</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;observationCode&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
          linkedObservation.effectiveTime<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">effectiveTime</span><b> then </b>ObservationEffectiveFromEffectiveTime<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">effectiveTime</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">observation</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy">;</span>
          linkedObservation<b> where </b>linkedObservation.effectiveTime.empty()<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>observation.effective = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'dateTime'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">effectiveDateTime</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>            linkedObservation<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>effectiveDateTime.extension = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Extension'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">absentReason</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>              linkedObservation<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>absentReason.url = <span style="color: blue">'http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/data-absent-reason'</span> <i>&quot;url&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
              linkedObservation<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>absentReason.value = <b>cast</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'unknown'</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: blue">'code'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;valueCode&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
            <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;dataAbsentReason&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
          <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;effectiveTimeAbsentReason&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
          linkedObservation.value<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">value</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>observation.value = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'CodeableConcept'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">cc</span><b> then </b>CDCodeableConcept<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">value</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">cc</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;observationValue&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
          linkedObservation<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span> fhirProcedure.partOf = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Reference'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">partOfRef</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> partOfRef.reference = <span style="color: navy">(</span>'urn:uuid:' + %observation.id<span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;partOf&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
        <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;linkedObservationResource&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;linkedObservationTemplate&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;linkedObservation&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Référence dans la section FHIR.</span>
  procedure<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span> compSection.entry = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Reference'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">sectionRef</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> sectionRef.reference = <span style="color: navy">(</span>'urn:uuid:' + %fhirProcedure.id<span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;sectionEntry&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
<span style="color: navy">}

</span><span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Auteur CDA -&gt; recorder Procedure</span>
<b>group </b>ProcedureRecorderFromAssignedAuthor<span style="color: navy">(</span><b>source</b> <span style="color: maroon">assignedAuthor</span>, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">fhirProcedure</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>Procedure, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">bundle</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>Bundle<span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>  assignedAuthor<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span> bundle.entry<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">practitionerEntry</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> practitionerEntry.resource = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Practitioner'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">practitioner</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> practitioner.id = <b>uuid</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> practitionerEntry.fullUrl = <span style="color: navy">(</span>'urn:uuid:' + %practitioner.id<span style="color: navy">)</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    assignedAuthor<b> then </b>MapCDAAssignedEntityToPractitioner<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">assignedAuthor</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">practitioner</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;practitionerBase&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    assignedAuthor<b> then </b>MapCDAAssignedEntityToFrenchPractitioner<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">assignedAuthor</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">practitioner</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;practitionerFR&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>

      representedOrganization<b> then </b>MapCDAOrganizationToFrenchOrganization<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">representedOrganization</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">organization</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;organizationFR&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      assignedAuthor<b> then </b>MapCDAAssignedEntityToPractitionerRole<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">assignedAuthor</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">practitionerRole</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">practitioner</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">organization</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;roleBase&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      assignedAuthor<b> then </b>MapCDAAssignedEntityToFrenchPractitionerRole<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">assignedAuthor</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">practitionerRole</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">practitioner</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">organization</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;roleFR&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      assignedAuthor<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span> fhirProcedure.recorder = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Reference'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">recorderRef</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> recorderRef.reference = <span style="color: navy">(</span>'urn:uuid:' + %practitionerRole.id<span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;recorderRole&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;withOrganization&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    assignedAuthor<b> where </b>assignedAuthor.representedOrganization.empty()<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span> fhirProcedure.recorder = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Reference'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">recorderRef</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> recorderRef.reference = <span style="color: navy">(</span>'urn:uuid:' + %practitioner.id<span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;recorderPractitionerOnly&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;recorder&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
<span style="color: navy">}

</span><span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Performer CDA -&gt; performer Procedure</span>
<b>group </b>ProcedurePerformerFromAssignedEntity<span style="color: navy">(</span><b>source</b> <span style="color: maroon">assignedEntity</span>, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">fhirProcedure</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>Procedure, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">bundle</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>Bundle<span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy"> {

</span>    assignedEntity<b> then </b>MapCDAAssignedEntityToPractitioner<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">assignedEntity</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">practitioner</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;practitionerBase&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    assignedEntity<b> then </b>MapCDAAssignedEntityToFrenchPractitioner<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">assignedEntity</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">practitioner</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;practitionerFR&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    assignedEntity.representedOrganization<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">representedOrganization</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span> bundle.entry<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">organizationEntry</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> organizationEntry.resource = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Organization'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">organization</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> organization.id = <b>uuid</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> organizationEntry.fullUrl = <span style="color: navy">(</span>'urn:uuid:' + %organization.id<span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> bundle.entry<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">roleEntry</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> roleEntry.resource = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'PractitionerRole'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">practitionerRole</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> practitionerRole.id = <b>uuid</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> roleEntry.fullUrl = <span style="color: navy">(</span>'urn:uuid:' + %practitionerRole.id<span style="color: navy">)</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      representedOrganization<b> then </b>MapCDAOrganizationToOrganization<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">representedOrganization</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">organization</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;organizationBase&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      representedOrganization<b> then </b>MapCDAOrganizationToFrenchOrganization<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">representedOrganization</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">organization</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;organizationFR&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      assignedEntity<b> then </b>MapCDAAssignedEntityToPractitionerRole<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">assignedEntity</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">practitionerRole</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">practitioner</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">organization</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;roleBase&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      assignedEntity<b> then </b>MapCDAAssignedEntityToFrenchPractitionerRole<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">assignedEntity</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">practitionerRole</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">practitioner</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">organization</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;roleFR&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      assignedEntity<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span> fhirProcedure.performer<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">performer</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> performer.actor = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Reference'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">actorRef</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> actorRef.reference = <span style="color: navy">(</span>'urn:uuid:' + %practitionerRole.id<span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;performerRole&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;withOrganization&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    assignedEntity<b> where </b>assignedEntity.representedOrganization.empty()<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span> fhirProcedure.performer<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">performer</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> performer.actor = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Reference'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">actorRef</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> actorRef.reference = <span style="color: navy">(</span>'urn:uuid:' + %practitioner.id<span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;performerPractitionerOnly&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;performer&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>

</span><span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">4. TRAITEMENTS</span>
<b>group </b>PatientSummaryMedicationSection<span style="color: navy">(</span><b>source</b> <span style="color: maroon">section</span>, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">compSection</span>, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">bundle</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>Bundle, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">patient</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>Patient<span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Section traitements.</span>
  section.templateId<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">sectionTid</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    sectionTid.root<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">sectionRoot</span><b> where </b>sectionRoot = '1.2.250.1.213.1.1.2.143'<b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      section.entry<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">entry</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>        entry.substanceAdministration<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">substanceAdministration</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>          substanceAdministration.templateId<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">treatmentTid</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>            treatmentTid.root<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">treatmentRoot</span><b> where </b>treatmentRoot = '1.2.250.1.213.1.1.3.42'<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span> bundle.entry<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">medicationStatementEntry</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> medicationStatementEntry.resource = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'MedicationStatement'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">medicationStatement</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> medicationStatement.id = <b>uuid</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> medicationStatementEntry.fullUrl = <span style="color: navy">(</span>'urn:uuid:' + %medicationStatement.id<span style="color: navy">)</span><b> then </b>PatientSummaryMedicationStatementFromSubstanceAdministration<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">substanceAdministration</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">medicationStatement</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">compSection</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">bundle</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">patient</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;medicationStatement&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
          <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;treatmentTemplate&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
        <span style="color: navy">}</span><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      <span style="color: navy">}</span><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;medicationSection&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;sectionTemplate&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
<span style="color: navy">}

</span><span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Administration CDA -&gt; MedicationStatement</span>
<b>group </b>PatientSummaryMedicationStatementFromSubstanceAdministration<span style="color: navy">(</span><b>source</b> <span style="color: maroon">substanceAdministration</span>, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">medicationStatement</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>MedicationStatement, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">compSection</span>, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">bundle</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>Bundle, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">patient</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>Patient<span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Statut, patient et catégorie.</span>
  substanceAdministration<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>medicationStatement.status = <span style="color: blue">'unknown'</span> <i>&quot;statusDefault&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  substanceAdministration.statusCode<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">statusCode</span><b> then </b>MedicationStatementStatusFromCdaStatus<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">statusCode</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">medicationStatement</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;status&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  substanceAdministration.id<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">id</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>medicationStatement.identifier = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Identifier'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">identifier</span><b> then </b>II<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">id</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">identifier</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;identifier&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  substanceAdministration<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span> medicationStatement.subject = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Reference'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">subjectRef</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> subjectRef.reference = <span style="color: navy">(</span>'urn:uuid:' + %patient.id<span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;subject&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  substanceAdministration.code<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">treatmentCode</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>medicationStatement.category = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'CodeableConcept'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">category</span><b> then </b>CDCodeableConcept<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">treatmentCode</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">category</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;category&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Médicament, période et posologie.</span>
  substanceAdministration.consumable<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">consumable</span><b> then </b>MedicationResourceFromConsumable<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">consumable</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">medicationStatement</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">bundle</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;medication&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  substanceAdministration.effectiveTime<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">effectiveTime</span><b> then </b>MedicationStatementEffectiveFromEffectiveTime<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">effectiveTime</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">medicationStatement</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;effective&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  substanceAdministration<b> then </b>MedicationMainDosageFromSubstanceAdministration<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">substanceAdministration</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">medicationStatement</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;mainDosage&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Motif et commentaire.</span>
  substanceAdministration.entryRelationship<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">er</span><b> then </b>MedicationEntryRelationship<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">er</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">medicationStatement</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Posologies subordonnées.</span>
  substanceAdministration.entryRelationship<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">er</span><b> where </b>er.typeCode = 'COMP'<b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    er.substanceAdministration<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">childAdministration</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>medicationStatement.dosage<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">childDosage</span><b> then </b>MedicationChildDosageFromSubstanceAdministration<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">childAdministration</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">substanceAdministration</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">childDosage</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;childDosage&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;childTreatment&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Référence dans la section FHIR.</span>
  substanceAdministration<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span> compSection.entry = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Reference'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">sectionRef</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> sectionRef.reference = <span style="color: navy">(</span>'urn:uuid:' + %medicationStatement.id<span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;sectionEntry&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
<span style="color: navy">}

</span><span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Statut CDA -&gt; MedicationStatement.status</span>
<b>group </b>MedicationStatementStatusFromCdaStatus<span style="color: navy">(</span><b>source</b> <span style="color: maroon">statusCode</span>, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">medicationStatement</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>MedicationStatement<span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>  statusCode.code<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">code</span><b> where </b>code = 'completed'<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>medicationStatement.status = <span style="color: blue">'completed'</span> <i>&quot;completed&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  statusCode.code<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">code</span><b> where </b>code = 'active'<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>medicationStatement.status = <span style="color: blue">'active'</span> <i>&quot;active&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  statusCode.code<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">code</span><b> where </b>code = 'aborted'<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>medicationStatement.status = <span style="color: blue">'stopped'</span> <i>&quot;aborted&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  statusCode.code<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">code</span><b> where </b>code = 'cancelled'<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>medicationStatement.status = <span style="color: blue">'stopped'</span> <i>&quot;cancelled&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  statusCode.code<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">code</span><b> where </b>code = 'suspended'<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>medicationStatement.status = <span style="color: blue">'on-hold'</span> <i>&quot;suspended&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
<span style="color: navy">}

</span><span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Produit de santé CDA -&gt; Medication + référence depuis MedicationStatement</span>
<b>group </b>MedicationResourceFromConsumable<span style="color: navy">(</span><b>source</b> <span style="color: maroon">consumable</span>, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">medicationStatement</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>MedicationStatement, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">bundle</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>Bundle<span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>  consumable.manufacturedProduct<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">manufacturedProduct</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    manufacturedProduct.manufacturedMaterial<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">manufacturedMaterial</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span> bundle.entry<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">medicationEntry</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> medicationEntry.resource = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Medication'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">medication</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> medication.id = <b>uuid</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> medicationEntry.fullUrl = <span style="color: navy">(</span>'urn:uuid:' + %medication.id<span style="color: navy">)</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      manufacturedMaterial<b> then </b>MedicationFromManufacturedMaterial<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">manufacturedMaterial</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">medication</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;medicationContent&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      manufacturedMaterial<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span> medicationStatement.medication = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Reference'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">medicationRef</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> medicationRef.reference = <span style="color: navy">(</span>'urn:uuid:' + %medication.id<span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;medicationReference&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;medication&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span><span style="color: navy">;</span>

</span><span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Contenu du médicament</span>
<b>group </b>MedicationFromManufacturedMaterial<span style="color: navy">(</span><b>source</b> <span style="color: maroon">manufacturedMaterial</span>, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">medication</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>Medication<span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy"> {

</span>    medicationName.xmlText<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">nameText</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>code.text = <b>cast</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">nameText</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: blue">'string'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;codeText&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;nameOnly&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  manufacturedMaterial.pharm:formCode<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">formCode</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>medication.form = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'CodeableConcept'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">form</span><b> then </b>CDCodeableConcept<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">formCode</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">form</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;form&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  manufacturedMaterial.pharm:ingredient<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">ingredient</span><b> then </b>MedicationIngredientFromPharmIngredient<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">ingredient</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">medication</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;ingredient&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>

</span>  ingredient.pharm:ingredient<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">innerIngredient</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    innerIngredient.pharm:code<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">ingredientCode</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span> medication.ingredient<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">fhirIngredient</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> fhirIngredient.item = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'CodeableConcept'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">item</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {

      ingredient.pharm:quantity<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">quantity</span><b> then </b>MedicationIngredientStrengthFromPharmQuantity<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">quantity</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">fhirIngredient</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;strength&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;ingredient&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;innerIngredient&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>

</span><span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Dosage de l’ingrédient</span>

</span>  quantity.numerator<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">numerator</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>fhirIngredient.strength = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Ratio'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">strength</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    numerator<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>strength.numerator = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Quantity'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">numeratorQuantity</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {

      numerator.unit<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">unit</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>numeratorQuantity.unit = <b>cast</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">unit</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: blue">'string'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;numeratorUnit&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;numerator&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    quantity.denominator<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">denominator</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>strength.denominator = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Quantity'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">denominatorQuantity</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      denominator.value<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">value</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>denominatorQuantity.value = <b>cast</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">value</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: blue">'decimal'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;denominatorValue&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>

    <span style="color: navy">}</span><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;strength&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>

</span><span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Période du traitement</span>

</span>  effectiveTime.low<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">low</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>medicationStatement.effective = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Period'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">period</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    low<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>period.start = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'dateTime'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">start</span><b> then </b>TSDateTime<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">low</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">start</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;start&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    effectiveTime.high<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">high</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      high.value<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">value</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>period.end = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'dateTime'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">end</span><b> then </b>TSDateTime<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">high</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">end</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;end&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;periodByLow&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  effectiveTime.high<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">high</span><b> where </b>effectiveTime.low.empty()<b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    high.value<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">value</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>medicationStatement.effective = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Period'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">period</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      high<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>period.end = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'dateTime'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">end</span><b> then </b>TSDateTime<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">high</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">end</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;endOnly&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;period&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;periodByHigh&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>

</span><span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Création conditionnelle du dosage principal</span>
<b>group </b>MedicationMainDosageFromSubstanceAdministration<span style="color: navy">(</span><b>source</b> <span style="color: maroon">substanceAdministration</span>, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">medicationStatement</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>MedicationStatement<span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>  substanceAdministration.routeCode<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">routeCode</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>medicationStatement.dosage<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">dosage</span><b> then </b>MedicationMainDosageContent<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">substanceAdministration</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">dosage</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;dosageByRoute&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  substanceAdministration.doseQuantity<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">doseQuantity</span><b> where </b>substanceAdministration.routeCode.empty()<b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    doseQuantity.low<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">low</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>medicationStatement.dosage<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">dosage</span><b> then </b>MedicationMainDosageContent<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">substanceAdministration</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">dosage</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;dosageByDoseLow&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    doseQuantity.high<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">high</span><b> where </b>doseQuantity.low.empty()<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>medicationStatement.dosage<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">dosage</span><b> then </b>MedicationMainDosageContent<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">substanceAdministration</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">dosage</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;dosageByDoseHigh&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;dosageByDose&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  substanceAdministration.rateQuantity<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">rateQuantity</span><b> where </b>substanceAdministration.routeCode.empty() and substanceAdministration.doseQuantity.empty()<b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    rateQuantity.low<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">low</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>medicationStatement.dosage<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">dosage</span><b> then </b>MedicationMainDosageContent<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">substanceAdministration</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">dosage</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;dosageByRateLow&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    rateQuantity.high<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">high</span><b> where </b>rateQuantity.low.empty()<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>medicationStatement.dosage<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">dosage</span><b> then </b>MedicationMainDosageContent<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">substanceAdministration</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">dosage</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;dosageByRateHigh&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;dosageByRate&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  substanceAdministration.effectiveTime<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">effectiveTime</span><b> where </b>substanceAdministration.routeCode.empty() and substanceAdministration.doseQuantity.empty() and substanceAdministration.rateQuantity.empty()<b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    effectiveTime.period<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">period</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>medicationStatement.dosage<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">dosage</span><b> then </b>MedicationMainDosageContent<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">substanceAdministration</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">dosage</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;dosageByTiming&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;dosageByTiming&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  substanceAdministration.maxDoseQuantity<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">maxDoseQuantity</span><b> where </b>substanceAdministration.routeCode.empty() and substanceAdministration.doseQuantity.empty() and substanceAdministration.rateQuantity.empty()<b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {

</span>      numerator.value<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">value</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>medicationStatement.dosage<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">dosage</span><b> then </b>MedicationMainDosageContent<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">substanceAdministration</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">dosage</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;dosageByMaxDose&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>

  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;dosageByMaxDose&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
<span style="color: navy">}

</span><span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Contenu du dosage</span>
<b>group </b>MedicationMainDosageContent<span style="color: navy">(</span><b>source</b> <span style="color: maroon">substanceAdministration</span>, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">dosage</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>  substanceAdministration.effectiveTime<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">effectiveTime</span><b> then </b>MedicationDosageTimingFromEffectiveTime<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">effectiveTime</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">dosage</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;timing&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  substanceAdministration.routeCode<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">routeCode</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>dosage.route = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'CodeableConcept'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">route</span><b> then </b>CDCodeableConcept<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">routeCode</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">route</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;route&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  substanceAdministration.doseQuantity<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">doseQuantity</span><b> then </b>MedicationDosageDoseFromDoseQuantity<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">doseQuantity</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">dosage</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;dose&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  substanceAdministration.rateQuantity<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">rateQuantity</span><b> then </b>MedicationDosageRateFromRateQuantity<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">rateQuantity</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">dosage</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;rate&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  substanceAdministration.maxDoseQuantity<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">maxDoseQuantity</span><b> then </b>MedicationDosageMaxDoseFromMaxDoseQuantity<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">maxDoseQuantity</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">dosage</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;maxDose&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
<span style="color: navy">}

</span><span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Fréquence / rythme</span>
<b>group </b>MedicationDosageTimingFromEffectiveTime<span style="color: navy">(</span><b>source</b> <span style="color: maroon">effectiveTime</span>, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">dosage</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>  effectiveTime.period<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">period</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>dosage.timing = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Timing'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">timing</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    period<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>timing.repeat<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">repeat</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      period.value<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">value</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>repeat.period = <b>cast</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">value</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: blue">'decimal'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;periodValue&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      period.unit<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">unit</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>repeat.periodUnit = <b>cast</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">unit</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: blue">'code'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;periodUnit&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;repeat&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    period.translation<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">translation</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      translation.originalText<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">originalText</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {

  doseQuantity.high<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">high</span><b> where </b>doseQuantity.low.empty()<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span> dosage.doseAndRate<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">doseAndRate</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> doseAndRate.dose = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Range'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">doseRange</span><b> then </b>MedicationRangeFromLowHigh<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">doseQuantity</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">doseRange</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;doseRangeByHigh&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>

</span>      value<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>lowQuantity.value = <b>cast</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">value</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: blue">'decimal'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;lowValue&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      low.unit<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">unit</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>lowQuantity.unit = <b>cast</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">unit</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: blue">'string'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;lowUnit&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>

  <span style="color: navy">}</span><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  srcQuantity.high<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">high</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {

      high.unit<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">unit</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>highQuantity.unit = <b>cast</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">unit</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: blue">'string'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;highUnit&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>

</span><span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Ratio numerator/denominator</span>

</span>      value<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>numeratorQuantity.value = <b>cast</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">value</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: blue">'decimal'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;numeratorValue&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      numerator.unit<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">unit</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>numeratorQuantity.unit = <b>cast</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">unit</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: blue">'string'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;numeratorUnit&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>

  <span style="color: navy">}</span><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  srcRatio.denominator<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">denominator</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    denominator.value<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">value</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>ratio.denominator = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Quantity'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">denominatorQuantity</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      value<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>denominatorQuantity.value = <b>cast</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">value</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: blue">'decimal'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;denominatorValue&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      denominator.unit<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">unit</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>denominatorQuantity.unit = <b>cast</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">unit</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: blue">'string'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;denominatorUnit&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>

</span><span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Motif et commentaire</span>
<b>group </b>MedicationEntryRelationship<span style="color: navy">(</span><b>source</b> <span style="color: maroon">er</span>, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">medicationStatement</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>MedicationStatement<span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>  er.act<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">reasonAct</span><b> where </b>er.typeCode = 'RSON'<b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
