</span>      tid.root<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">root</span><b> where </b>root = '1.2.250.1.213.1.1.3.36'<b> then </b>MedicationReasonFromAct<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">reasonAct</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">medicationStatement</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;reason&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;reasonTemplate&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;reasonAct&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  er.act<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">commentAct</span><b> where </b>er.typeCode = 'SUBJ'<b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    commentAct.templateId<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">tid</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      tid.root<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">root</span><b> where </b>root = '1.2.250.1.213.1.1.3.32' <i>&quot;commentNotMapped&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;commentTemplate&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;commentAct&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
<span style="color: navy">}

</span><span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Motif du traitement</span>
<b>group </b>MedicationReasonFromAct<span style="color: navy">(</span><b>source</b> <span style="color: maroon">reasonAct</span>, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">medicationStatement</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>MedicationStatement<span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>  reasonAct.code<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">reasonCode</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>medicationStatement.reasonCode = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'CodeableConcept'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">reason</span><b> then </b>CDCodeableConcept<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">reasonCode</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">reason</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;reasonCode&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
<span style="color: navy">}

</span><span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Posologie subordonnée</span>
<b>group </b>MedicationChildDosageFromSubstanceAdministration<span style="color: navy">(</span><b>source</b> <span style="color: maroon">childAdministration</span>, <b>source</b> <span style="color: maroon">parentAdministration</span>, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">childDosage</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>  childAdministration.effectiveTime<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">childEffectiveTime</span><b> then </b>MedicationChildTimingFromEffectiveTime<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">childEffectiveTime</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">childDosage</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;childTiming&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  parentAdministration.routeCode<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">routeCode</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>childDosage.route = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'CodeableConcept'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">route</span><b> then </b>CDCodeableConcept<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">routeCode</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">route</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;childRoute&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  childAdministration.doseQuantity<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">doseQuantity</span><b> then </b>MedicationDosageDoseFromDoseQuantity<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">doseQuantity</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">childDosage</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;childDose&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  childAdministration.rateQuantity<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">rateQuantity</span><b> then </b>MedicationDosageRateFromRateQuantity<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">rateQuantity</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">childDosage</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;childRate&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
<span style="color: navy">}

</span><span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Rythme de la posologie subordonnée</span>
<b>group </b>MedicationChildTimingFromEffectiveTime<span style="color: navy">(</span><b>source</b> <span style="color: maroon">childEffectiveTime</span>, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">childDosage</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>  childEffectiveTime<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>childDosage.timing = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Timing'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">timing</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    childEffectiveTime<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>timing.repeat<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">repeat</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      childEffectiveTime.comp<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">comp</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>        comp.low<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">low</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>repeat.bounds = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Period'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">boundsPeriod</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>          low<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>boundsPeriod.start = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'dateTime'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">start</span><b> then </b>TSDateTime<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">low</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">start</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;boundsStart&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
        <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;bounds&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
        comp.period<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">period</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>          period.value<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">value</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>repeat.period = <b>cast</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">value</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: blue">'decimal'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;periodValue&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
          period.unit<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">unit</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>repeat.periodUnit = <b>cast</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">unit</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: blue">'code'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;periodUnit&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
          period.translation<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">translation</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>            translation.originalText<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">originalText</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>              originalText.reference<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">ref</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>                ref.value<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">value</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>childDosage.text = <b>cast</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">value</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: blue">'string'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;childDosageText&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
              <span style="color: navy">}</span><span style="color: navy">;</span>
            <span style="color: navy">}</span><span style="color: navy">;</span>
          <span style="color: navy">}</span><span style="color: navy">;</span>
        <span style="color: navy">}</span><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      <span style="color: navy">}</span><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;repeat&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;timing&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>

</span><span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">5. EFFETS INDÉSIRABLES MÉDICAMENTEUX</span>
<b>group </b>PatientSummaryAdverseDrugReactionSection<span style="color: navy">(</span><b>source</b> <span style="color: maroon">section</span>, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">compSection</span>, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">bundle</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>Bundle, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">patient</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>Patient<span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Section effets indésirables.</span>
  section.templateId<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">sectionTid</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    sectionTid.root<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">sectionRoot</span><b> where </b>sectionRoot = '1.2.250.1.213.1.1.2.247'<b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      section.entry<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">entry</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>        entry.observation<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">adverseObservation</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>          adverseObservation.templateId<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">tid</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>            tid.root<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">root</span><b> where </b>root = '1.2.250.1.213.1.1.3.210'<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span> bundle.entry<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">adverseEntry</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> adverseEntry.resource = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'AdverseEvent'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">adverseEvent</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> adverseEvent.id = <b>uuid</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> adverseEntry.fullUrl = <span style="color: navy">(</span>'urn:uuid:' + %adverseEvent.id<span style="color: navy">)</span><b> then </b>PatientSummaryAdverseEventFromObservation<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">adverseObservation</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">adverseEvent</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">compSection</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">bundle</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">patient</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;adverseEvent&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
          <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;adverseTemplate&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
        <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;adverseObservation&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      <span style="color: navy">}</span><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;adverseSection&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;sectionTemplate&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
<span style="color: navy">}

</span><span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Observation CDA -&gt; AdverseEvent</span>
<b>group </b>PatientSummaryAdverseEventFromObservation<span style="color: navy">(</span><b>source</b> <span style="color: maroon">adverseObservation</span>, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">adverseEvent</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>AdverseEvent, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">compSection</span>, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">bundle</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>Bundle, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">patient</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>Patient<span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Statut, identifiant et patient.</span>
  adverseObservation<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>adverseEvent.actuality = <span style="color: blue">'actual'</span> <i>&quot;actualityDefault&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  adverseObservation.moodCode<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">mood</span><b> where </b>mood = 'INT'<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>adverseEvent.actuality = <span style="color: blue">'potential'</span> <i>&quot;actualityPotential&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  adverseObservation.id<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">id</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>adverseEvent.identifier = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Identifier'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">identifier</span><b> then </b>II<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">id</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">identifier</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;identifier&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  adverseObservation<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span> adverseEvent.subject = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Reference'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">subjectRef</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> subjectRef.reference = <span style="color: navy">(</span>'urn:uuid:' + %patient.id<span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;subject&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Catégorie de l’effet indésirable.</span>
  adverseObservation.code<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">code</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>adverseEvent.category = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'CodeableConcept'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">category</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    code<b> then </b>CDCodeableConcept<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">code</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">category</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;categoryCoding&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    adverseObservation.text<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">text</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      text.reference<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">reference</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>        reference.value<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">value</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>category.text = <b>cast</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">value</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: blue">'string'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;categoryText&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      <span style="color: navy">}</span><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;category&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Dates.</span>
  adverseObservation.effectiveTime<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">effectiveTime</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    effectiveTime.low<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">low</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>adverseEvent.date = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'dateTime'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">date</span><b> then </b>TSDateTime<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">low</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">date</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;date&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    effectiveTime.high<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">high</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      high.value<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">value</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>adverseEvent.detected = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'dateTime'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">detected</span><b> then </b>TSDateTime<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">high</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">detected</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;detected&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;detected&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;dates&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Informations complémentaires.</span>
  adverseObservation.entryRelationship<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">er</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Traitement suspect.</span>
    er.substanceAdministration<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">treatment</span><b> where </b>er.typeCode = 'COMP'<b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      treatment.templateId<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">tid</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>        tid.root<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">root</span><b> where </b>root = '1.2.250.1.213.1.1.3.42'<b> then </b>AdverseEventSuspectMedicationFromTreatment<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">treatment</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">adverseObservation</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">adverseEvent</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">bundle</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">patient</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;suspectMedication&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;treatmentTemplate&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;treatment&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Réaction observée.</span>
    er.observation<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">reactionObservation</span><b> where </b>er.typeCode = 'MFST'<b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      reactionObservation.templateId<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">tid</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>        tid.root<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">root</span><b> where </b>root = '1.2.250.1.213.1.1.3.37'<b> then </b>AdverseEventResultingConditionFromReaction<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">reactionObservation</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">adverseEvent</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">bundle</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">patient</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;reaction&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;reactionTemplate&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;reaction&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Gravité.</span>
    er.observation<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">seriousnessObservation</span><b> where </b>er.typeCode = 'SUBJ'<b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      seriousnessObservation.templateId<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">tid</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>        tid.root<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">root</span><b> where </b>root = '1.2.250.1.213.1.1.3.212'<b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>          seriousnessObservation.value<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">value</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>adverseEvent.seriousness = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'CodeableConcept'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">seriousness</span><b> then </b>CDCodeableConcept<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">value</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">seriousness</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;seriousness&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
        <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;seriousness&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;seriousnessTemplate&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;seriousness&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Évolution.</span>
    er.observation<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">outcomeObservation</span><b> where </b>er.typeCode = 'SUBJ'<b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      outcomeObservation.templateId<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">tid</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>        tid.root<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">root</span><b> where </b>root = '1.2.250.1.213.1.1.3.213'<b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>          outcomeObservation.value<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">value</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>adverseEvent.outcome = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'CodeableConcept'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">outcome</span><b> then </b>CDCodeableConcept<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">value</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">outcome</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;outcome&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
        <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;outcome&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;outcomeTemplate&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;outcome&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Commentaire non mappé pour l’instant.</span>
    er.act<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">commentAct</span><b> where </b>er.typeCode = 'SUBJ'<b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      commentAct.templateId<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">tid</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>        tid.root<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">root</span><b> where </b>root = '1.2.250.1.213.1.1.3.32' <i>&quot;commentNotMapped&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;commentTemplate&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;comment&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Référence dans la section FHIR.</span>
  adverseObservation<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span> compSection.entry = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Reference'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">sectionRef</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> sectionRef.reference = <span style="color: navy">(</span>'urn:uuid:' + %adverseEvent.id<span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;sectionEntry&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
<span style="color: navy">}

</span><span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Traitement suspect -&gt; MedicationStatement + suspectEntity</span>
<b>group </b>AdverseEventSuspectMedicationFromTreatment<span style="color: navy">(</span><b>source</b> <span style="color: maroon">treatment</span>, <b>source</b> <span style="color: maroon">adverseObservation</span>, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">adverseEvent</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>AdverseEvent, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">bundle</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>Bundle, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">patient</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>Patient<span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>  treatment<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span> bundle.entry<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">medicationStatementEntry</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> medicationStatementEntry.resource = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'MedicationStatement'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">medicationStatement</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> medicationStatement.id = <b>uuid</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> medicationStatementEntry.fullUrl = <span style="color: navy">(</span>'urn:uuid:' + %medicationStatement.id<span style="color: navy">)</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">MedicationStatement lié au médicament suspect.</span>
    treatment<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>medicationStatement.status = <span style="color: blue">'unknown'</span> <i>&quot;statusDefault&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    treatment.statusCode<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">statusCode</span><b> then </b>MedicationStatementStatusFromCdaStatus<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">statusCode</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">medicationStatement</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;status&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    treatment.id<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">id</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>medicationStatement.identifier = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Identifier'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">identifier</span><b> then </b>II<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">id</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">identifier</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;identifier&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    treatment<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span> medicationStatement.subject = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Reference'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">subjectRef</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> subjectRef.reference = <span style="color: navy">(</span>'urn:uuid:' + %patient.id<span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;subject&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    treatment.code<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">treatmentCode</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>medicationStatement.category = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'CodeableConcept'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">category</span><b> then </b>CDCodeableConcept<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">treatmentCode</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">category</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;category&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    treatment.consumable<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">consumable</span><b> then </b>MedicationResourceFromConsumable<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">consumable</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">medicationStatement</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">bundle</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;medication&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    treatment.effectiveTime<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">effectiveTime</span><b> then </b>MedicationStatementEffectiveFromEffectiveTime<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">effectiveTime</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">medicationStatement</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;effective&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    treatment<b> then </b>MedicationMainDosageFromSubstanceAdministration<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">treatment</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">medicationStatement</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;dosage&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Lien avec AdverseEvent.suspectEntity.</span>
    treatment<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span> adverseEvent.suspectEntity<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">suspectEntity</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> suspectEntity.instance = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Reference'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">instanceRef</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> instanceRef.reference = <span style="color: navy">(</span>'urn:uuid:' + %medicationStatement.id<span style="color: navy">)</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Imputabilité.</span>
      adverseObservation.entryRelationship<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">causalityEr</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>        causalityEr.observation<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">causalityObservation</span><b> where </b>causalityEr.typeCode = 'SUBJ'<b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>          causalityObservation.templateId<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">tid</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>            tid.root<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">root</span><b> where </b>root = '1.2.250.1.213.1.1.3.211'<b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>              causalityObservation.value<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">value</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span> suspectEntity.causality<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">causality</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> causality.assessment = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'CodeableConcept'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">assessment</span><b> then </b>CDCodeableConcept<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">value</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">assessment</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;causalityAssessment&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
            <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;causality&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
          <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;causalityTemplate&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
        <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;causalityObservation&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;causality&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;suspectEntity&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;suspectMedication&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
<span style="color: navy">}

</span><span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Réaction observée -&gt; Condition + resultingCondition</span>
<b>group </b>AdverseEventResultingConditionFromReaction<span style="color: navy">(</span><b>source</b> <span style="color: maroon">reactionObservation</span>, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">adverseEvent</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>AdverseEvent, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">bundle</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>Bundle, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">patient</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>Patient<span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>  reactionObservation<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span> bundle.entry<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">conditionEntry</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> conditionEntry.resource = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Condition'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">condition</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> condition.id = <b>uuid</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> conditionEntry.fullUrl = <span style="color: navy">(</span>'urn:uuid:' + %condition.id<span style="color: navy">)</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Condition liée à la réaction.</span>
    reactionObservation.id<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">id</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>condition.identifier = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Identifier'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">identifier</span><b> then </b>II<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">id</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">identifier</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;identifier&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    reactionObservation<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span> condition.subject = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Reference'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">subjectRef</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> subjectRef.reference = <span style="color: navy">(</span>'urn:uuid:' + %patient.id<span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;subject&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    reactionObservation.code<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">code</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>condition.category = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'CodeableConcept'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">category</span><b> then </b>CDCodeableConcept<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">code</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">category</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;category&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    reactionObservation.value<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">value</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>condition.code = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'CodeableConcept'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">conditionCode</span><b> then </b>CDCodeableConcept<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">value</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">conditionCode</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;code&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    reactionObservation.effectiveTime<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">effectiveTime</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      effectiveTime.low<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">low</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>condition.onset = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'dateTime'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">onset</span><b> then </b>TSDateTime<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">low</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">onset</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;onset&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      effectiveTime.high<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">high</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>        high.value<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">value</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>condition.abatement = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'dateTime'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">abatement</span><b> then </b>TSDateTime<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">high</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">abatement</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;abatement&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;abatement&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Lien avec AdverseEvent.resultingCondition.</span>
    reactionObservation<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span> adverseEvent.resultingCondition = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Reference'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">conditionRef</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> conditionRef.reference = <span style="color: navy">(</span>'urn:uuid:' + %condition.id<span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;resultingCondition&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;reactionCondition&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
<span style="color: navy">}

</span><span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">6. VACCINATIONS</span>
<b>group </b>PatientSummaryImmunizationSection<span style="color: navy">(</span><b>source</b> <span style="color: maroon">section</span>, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">compSection</span>, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">bundle</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>Bundle, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">patient</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>Patient<span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Section vaccinations.</span>
  section.templateId<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">sectionTid</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    sectionTid.root<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">sectionRoot</span><b> where </b>sectionRoot = '1.2.250.1.213.1.1.2.147'<b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      section.entry<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">entry</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>        entry.substanceAdministration<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">substanceAdministration</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>          substanceAdministration.templateId<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">immunizationTid</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>            immunizationTid.root<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">immunizationRoot</span><b> where </b>immunizationRoot = '1.2.250.1.213.1.1.3.45'<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span> bundle.entry<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">immunizationEntry</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> immunizationEntry.resource = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Immunization'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">immunization</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> immunization.id = <b>uuid</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> immunizationEntry.fullUrl = <span style="color: navy">(</span>'urn:uuid:' + %immunization.id<span style="color: navy">)</span><b> then </b>PatientSummaryImmunizationFromSubstanceAdministration<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">substanceAdministration</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">immunization</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">compSection</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">bundle</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">patient</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;immunization&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
          <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;immunizationTemplate&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
        <span style="color: navy">}</span><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      <span style="color: navy">}</span><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;vaccinationSection&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;sectionTemplate&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
<span style="color: navy">}

</span><span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">substanceAdministration CDA -&gt; Immunization</span>
<b>group </b>PatientSummaryImmunizationFromSubstanceAdministration<span style="color: navy">(</span><b>source</b> <span style="color: maroon">substanceAdministration</span>, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">immunization</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>Immunization, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">compSection</span>, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">bundle</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>Bundle, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">patient</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>Patient<span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Statut, identifiant, patient et date.</span>
  substanceAdministration<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>immunization.status = <span style="color: blue">'completed'</span> <i>&quot;statusDefault&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  substanceAdministration.negationInd<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">negation</span><b> where </b>negation = 'true'<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>immunization.status = <span style="color: blue">'not-done'</span> <i>&quot;statusNotDoneByNegation&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  substanceAdministration.statusCode<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">statusCode</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    statusCode.code<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">code</span><b> where </b>code = 'completed'<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>immunization.status = <span style="color: blue">'completed'</span> <i>&quot;completed&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    statusCode.code<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">code</span><b> where </b>code = 'aborted'<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>immunization.status = <span style="color: blue">'not-done'</span> <i>&quot;aborted&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    statusCode.code<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">code</span><b> where </b>code = 'cancelled'<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>immunization.status = <span style="color: blue">'not-done'</span> <i>&quot;cancelled&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;status&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  substanceAdministration.id<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">id</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>immunization.identifier = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Identifier'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">identifier</span><b> then </b>II<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">id</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">identifier</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;identifier&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  substanceAdministration<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span> immunization.patient = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Reference'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">patientRef</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> patientRef.reference = <span style="color: navy">(</span>'urn:uuid:' + %patient.id<span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;patient&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  substanceAdministration.effectiveTime<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">effectiveTime</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>immunization.occurrence = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'dateTime'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">occurrenceDateTime</span><b> then </b>TSDateTime<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">effectiveTime</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">occurrenceDateTime</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;occurrenceDateTime&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Vaccin et numéro de lot.</span>
  substanceAdministration.consumable<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">consumable</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    consumable.manufacturedProduct<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">manufacturedProduct</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      manufacturedProduct.manufacturedMaterial<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">manufacturedMaterial</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>        manufacturedMaterial.code<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">vaccineCode</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>immunization.vaccineCode = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'CodeableConcept'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">code</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>          vaccineCode<b> then </b>CDCodeableConcept<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">vaccineCode</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">code</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;vaccineCoding&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
          substanceAdministration.text<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">text</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>            text.reference<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">reference</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>              reference.value<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">value</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>code.text = <b>cast</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">value</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: blue">'string'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;vaccineText&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
            <span style="color: navy">}</span><span style="color: navy">;</span>
          <span style="color: navy">}</span><span style="color: navy">;</span>
        <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;vaccineCode&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
        manufacturedMaterial.lotNumberText<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">lotNumberText</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>          lotNumberText.xmlText<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">lot</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>immunization.lotNumber = <b>cast</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">lot</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: blue">'string'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;lotNumber&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
        <span style="color: navy">}</span><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      <span style="color: navy">}</span><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;vaccine&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Voie d’administration.</span>
  substanceAdministration.routeCode<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">routeCode</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>immunization.route = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'CodeableConcept'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">route</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    routeCode<b> then </b>CDCodeableConcept<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">routeCode</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">route</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;routeCode&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    routeCode.originalText<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">originalText</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      originalText.reference<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">reference</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>        reference.value<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">value</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>route.text = <b>cast</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">value</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: blue">'string'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;routeText&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      <span style="color: navy">}</span><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;route&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Site d’administration.</span>
  substanceAdministration.approachSiteCode<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">siteCode</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>immunization.site = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'CodeableConcept'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">site</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    siteCode<b> then </b>CDCodeableConcept<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">siteCode</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">site</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;siteCode&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    siteCode.originalText<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">originalText</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      originalText.reference<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">reference</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>        reference.value<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">value</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>site.text = <b>cast</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">value</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: blue">'string'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;siteText&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      <span style="color: navy">}</span><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;site&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Protocole vaccinal.</span>
  substanceAdministration.code<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">seriesCode</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>immunization.protocolApplied<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">protocol</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    seriesCode.displayName<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">display</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>protocol.series = <b>cast</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">display</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: blue">'string'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;series&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    substanceAdministration.entryRelationship<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">er</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      er.observation<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">rankObservation</span><b> where </b>er.typeCode = 'SUBJ'<b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>        rankObservation.templateId<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">tid</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>          tid.root<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">root</span><b> where </b>root = '1.2.250.1.213.1.1.3.82'<b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>            rankObservation.value<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">value</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>              value.value<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">doseValue</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>protocol.doseNumber = <b>cast</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">doseValue</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: blue">'positiveInt'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;doseNumber&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
            <span style="color: navy">}</span><span style="color: navy">;</span>
          <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;rank&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
        <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;rankTemplate&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;rankObservation&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;doseNumber&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    substanceAdministration.consumable<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">consumable</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      consumable.manufacturedProduct<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">manufacturedProduct</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>        manufacturedProduct.manufacturedMaterial<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">manufacturedMaterial</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>          manufacturedMaterial.code<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">vaccineCode</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>            vaccineCode.translation<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">translation</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>protocol.targetDisease = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'CodeableConcept'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">targetDisease</span><b> then </b>CDCodeableConcept<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">translation</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">targetDisease</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;targetDisease&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
          <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;vaccineCode&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
        <span style="color: navy">}</span><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      <span style="color: navy">}</span><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;targetDisease&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;protocolApplied&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Vaccinateur.</span>
  substanceAdministration.performer<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">performer</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    performer.assignedEntity<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">assignedEntity</span><b> then </b>ImmunizationPerformerFromAssignedEntity<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">assignedEntity</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">immunization</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">bundle</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;performer&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Réaction et commentaire.</span>
  substanceAdministration.entryRelationship<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">er</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    er.observation<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">reactionObservation</span><b> where </b>er.typeCode = 'CAUS'<b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      reactionObservation.templateId<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">tid</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>        tid.root<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">root</span><b> where </b>root = '1.2.250.1.213.1.1.3.37'<b> then </b>ImmunizationReactionFromObservation<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">reactionObservation</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">immunization</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">bundle</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">patient</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;reaction&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;reactionTemplate&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;reactionObservation&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    er.act<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">commentAct</span><b> where </b>er.typeCode = 'SUBJ'<b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      commentAct.templateId<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">tid</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>        tid.root<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">root</span><b> where </b>root = '1.2.250.1.213.1.1.3.32'<b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>          commentAct.text<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">text</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>            text.reference<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">reference</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>              reference.value<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">value</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span> immunization.note = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Annotation'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">note</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> note.text = <b>cast</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">value</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: blue">'string'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;note&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
            <span style="color: navy">}</span><span style="color: navy">;</span>
          <span style="color: navy">}</span><span style="color: navy">;</span>
        <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;comment&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;commentTemplate&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;commentAct&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Référence dans la section FHIR.</span>
  substanceAdministration<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span> compSection.entry = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Reference'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">sectionRef</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> sectionRef.reference = <span style="color: navy">(</span>'urn:uuid:' + %immunization.id<span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;sectionEntry&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
<span style="color: navy">}

</span><span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Vaccinateur CDA -&gt; Practitioner / Organization / PractitionerRole</span>
<b>group </b>ImmunizationPerformerFromAssignedEntity<span style="color: navy">(</span><b>source</b> <span style="color: maroon">assignedEntity</span>, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">immunization</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>Immunization, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">bundle</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>Bundle<span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>  assignedEntity<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span> bundle.entry<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">practitionerEntry</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> practitionerEntry.resource = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Practitioner'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">practitioner</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> practitioner.id = <b>uuid</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> practitionerEntry.fullUrl = <span style="color: navy">(</span>'urn:uuid:' + %practitioner.id<span style="color: navy">)</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    assignedEntity<b> then </b>MapCDAAssignedEntityToPractitioner<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">assignedEntity</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">practitioner</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;practitionerBase&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    assignedEntity<b> then </b>MapCDAAssignedEntityToFrenchPractitioner<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">assignedEntity</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">practitioner</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;practitionerFR&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    assignedEntity.representedOrganization<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">representedOrganization</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span> bundle.entry<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">organizationEntry</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> organizationEntry.resource = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Organization'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">organization</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> organization.id = <b>uuid</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> organizationEntry.fullUrl = <span style="color: navy">(</span>'urn:uuid:' + %organization.id<span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> bundle.entry<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">roleEntry</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> roleEntry.resource = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'PractitionerRole'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">practitionerRole</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> practitionerRole.id = <b>uuid</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> roleEntry.fullUrl = <span style="color: navy">(</span>'urn:uuid:' + %practitionerRole.id<span style="color: navy">)</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      representedOrganization<b> then </b>MapCDAOrganizationToOrganization<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">representedOrganization</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">organization</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;organizationBase&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      representedOrganization<b> then </b>MapCDAOrganizationToFrenchOrganization<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">representedOrganization</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">organization</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;organizationFR&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      assignedEntity<b> then </b>MapCDAAssignedEntityToPractitionerRole<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">assignedEntity</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">practitionerRole</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">practitioner</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">organization</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;roleBase&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      assignedEntity<b> then </b>MapCDAAssignedEntityToFrenchPractitionerRole<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">assignedEntity</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">practitionerRole</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">practitioner</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">organization</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;roleFR&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      assignedEntity<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span> immunization.performer<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">performer</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> performer.actor = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Reference'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">actorRef</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> actorRef.reference = <span style="color: navy">(</span>'urn:uuid:' + %practitionerRole.id<span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;performerRole&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;withOrganization&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    assignedEntity<b> where </b>assignedEntity.representedOrganization.empty()<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span> immunization.performer<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">performer</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> performer.actor = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Reference'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">actorRef</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> actorRef.reference = <span style="color: navy">(</span>'urn:uuid:' + %practitioner.id<span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;performerPractitionerOnly&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;performer&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
<span style="color: navy">}

</span><span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Réaction observée -&gt; Observation + Immunization.reaction.detail</span>
<b>group </b>ImmunizationReactionFromObservation<span style="color: navy">(</span><b>source</b> <span style="color: maroon">reactionObservation</span>, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">immunization</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>Immunization, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">bundle</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>Bundle, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">patient</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>Patient<span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>  reactionObservation<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span> bundle.entry<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">observationEntry</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> observationEntry.resource = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Observation'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">reaction</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> reaction.id = <b>uuid</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> observationEntry.fullUrl = <span style="color: navy">(</span>'urn:uuid:' + %reaction.id<span style="color: navy">)</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Observation de réaction.</span>
    reactionObservation<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>reaction.status = <span style="color: blue">'final'</span> <i>&quot;status&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    reactionObservation.id<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">id</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>reaction.identifier = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Identifier'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">identifier</span><b> then </b>II<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">id</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">identifier</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;identifier&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    reactionObservation<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span> reaction.subject = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Reference'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">subjectRef</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> subjectRef.reference = <span style="color: navy">(</span>'urn:uuid:' + %patient.id<span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;subject&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    reactionObservation<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>reaction.category = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'CodeableConcept'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">category</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      reactionObservation<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>category.coding = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Coding'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">coding</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>        reactionObservation<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>coding.system = <span style="color: blue">'http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/observation-category'</span> <i>&quot;categorySystem&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
        reactionObservation<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>coding.code = <span style="color: blue">'exam'</span> <i>&quot;categoryCode&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
        reactionObservation<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>coding.display = <span style="color: blue">'Exam'</span> <i>&quot;categoryDisplay&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;categoryCoding&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;category&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    reactionObservation.code<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">code</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>reaction.code = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'CodeableConcept'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">cc</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      code<b> then </b>CDCodeableConcept<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">code</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">cc</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;code&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      reactionObservation.text<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">text</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>        text.reference<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">reference</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>          reference.value<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">value</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>cc.text = <b>cast</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">value</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: blue">'string'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;text&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
        <span style="color: navy">}</span><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;textBlock&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;reactionCode&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    reactionObservation.value<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">value</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>reaction.value = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'CodeableConcept'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">valueCodeableConcept</span><b> then </b>CDCodeableConcept<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">value</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">valueCodeableConcept</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Date de l’Observation.</span>
    reactionObservation.effectiveTime<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">effectiveTime</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      effectiveTime.value<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">value</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>reaction.effective = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'dateTime'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">effectiveDateTime</span><b> then </b>TSDateTime<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">effectiveTime</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">effectiveDateTime</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;effectiveDateTimeValue&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      effectiveTime.low<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">low</span><b> where </b>effectiveTime.value.empty()<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>reaction.effective = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'dateTime'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">effectiveDateTime</span><b> then </b>TSDateTime<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">low</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">effectiveDateTime</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;effectiveDateTimeLow&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      effectiveTime.high<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">high</span><b> where </b>effectiveTime.value.empty() and effectiveTime.low.empty()<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>reaction.effective = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'dateTime'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">effectiveDateTime</span><b> then </b>TSDateTime<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">high</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">effectiveDateTime</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;effectiveDateTimeHigh&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      effectiveTime<b> where </b>effectiveTime.value.empty() and effectiveTime.low.empty() and effectiveTime.high.empty()<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>reaction.effective = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'dateTime'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">effectiveDateTime</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>        effectiveTime<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>effectiveDateTime.extension = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Extension'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">absentReason</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>          effectiveTime<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>absentReason.url = <span style="color: blue">'http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/data-absent-reason'</span> <i>&quot;url&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
          effectiveTime<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>absentReason.value = <b>cast</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'unknown'</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: blue">'code'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;valueCode&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
        <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;dataAbsentReason&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;effectiveTimePresentWithoutValue&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    reactionObservation<b> where </b>reactionObservation.effectiveTime.empty()<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>reaction.effective = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'dateTime'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">effectiveDateTime</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      reactionObservation<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>effectiveDateTime.extension = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Extension'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">absentReason</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>        reactionObservation<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>absentReason.url = <span style="color: blue">'http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/data-absent-reason'</span> <i>&quot;url&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
