        reactionObservation<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>absentReason.value = <b>cast</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'unknown'</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: blue">'code'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;valueCode&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;dataAbsentReason&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;effectiveTimeAbsentReason&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Lien avec Immunization.reaction.</span>
    reactionObservation<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>immunization.reaction<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">immunizationReaction</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      reactionObservation.effectiveTime<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">effectiveTime</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>        effectiveTime.low<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">low</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>immunizationReaction.date = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'dateTime'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">reactionDate</span><b> then </b>TSDateTime<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">low</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">reactionDate</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;reactionDate&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;reactionDateBlock&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      reactionObservation<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span> immunizationReaction.detail = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Reference'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">detailRef</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> detailRef.reference = <span style="color: navy">(</span>'urn:uuid:' + %reaction.id<span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;reactionDetail&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;immunizationReaction&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;reaction&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
<span style="color: navy">}

</span><span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">7. OBSERVATIONS</span>
<span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">   Sections concernées :</span>
<span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">   - Constantes / signes vitaux</span>
<span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">   - Mode de vie / habitus</span>
<span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">   - Statut fonctionnel</span>
<span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">   - Résultats</span>
<span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">   - Facteurs de risques professionnels</span>
<span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">BASE COMMUNE DES OBSERVATIONS</span>
<b>group </b>PatientSummaryObservationBase<span style="color: navy">(</span><b>source</b> <span style="color: maroon">observation</span>, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">fhirObservation</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>Observation, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">patient</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>Patient<span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>  observation<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>fhirObservation.status = <span style="color: blue">'final'</span> <i>&quot;statusDefault&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  observation.statusCode<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">statusCode</span><b> then </b>ObservationStatusFromCdaStatus<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">statusCode</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">fhirObservation</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;status&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  observation.id<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">id</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>fhirObservation.identifier = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Identifier'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">identifier</span><b> then </b>II<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">id</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">identifier</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;identifier&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  observation<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span> fhirObservation.subject = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Reference'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">subjectRef</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> subjectRef.reference = <span style="color: navy">(</span>'urn:uuid:' + %patient.id<span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;subject&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  observation<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>fhirObservation.category = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'CodeableConcept'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">category</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    observation<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>category.extension = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Extension'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">absentReason</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      observation<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>absentReason.url = <span style="color: blue">'http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/data-absent-reason'</span> <i>&quot;url&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      observation<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>absentReason.value = <b>cast</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'unknown'</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: blue">'code'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;valueCode&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;dataAbsentReason&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;categoryAbsentReason&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  observation.code<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">code</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>fhirObservation.code = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'CodeableConcept'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">obsCode</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    code<b> then </b>CDCodeableConcept<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">code</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">obsCode</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;code&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    observation.text<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">text</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      text.reference<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">reference</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>        reference.value<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">value</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>obsCode.text = <b>cast</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">value</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: blue">'string'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;codeText&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      <span style="color: navy">}</span><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;observationCode&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  observation.effectiveTime<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">effectiveTime</span><b> then </b>ObservationEffectiveFromEffectiveTime<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">effectiveTime</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">fhirObservation</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  observation<b> where </b>observation.effectiveTime.empty()<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>fhirObservation.effective = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'dateTime'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">effectiveDateTime</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    observation<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>effectiveDateTime.extension = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Extension'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">absentReason</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      observation<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>absentReason.url = <span style="color: blue">'http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/data-absent-reason'</span> <i>&quot;url&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      observation<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>absentReason.value = <b>cast</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'unknown'</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: blue">'code'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;valueCode&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;dataAbsentReason&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;effectiveTimeAbsentReason&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  observation.value<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">value</span><b> then </b>ObservationValueFromCdaValue<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">value</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">fhirObservation</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  observation.interpretationCode<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">interpretationCode</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>fhirObservation.interpretation = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'CodeableConcept'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">interpretation</span><b> then </b>CDCodeableConcept<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">interpretationCode</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">interpretation</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;interpretation&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  observation.methodCode<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">methodCode</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>fhirObservation.method = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'CodeableConcept'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">method</span><b> then </b>CDCodeableConcept<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">methodCode</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">method</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;method&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  observation.targetSiteCode<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">targetSiteCode</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>fhirObservation.bodySite = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'CodeableConcept'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">bodySite</span><b> then </b>CDCodeableConcept<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">targetSiteCode</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">bodySite</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;bodySite&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  observation.code<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">code</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    code.qualifier<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">qualifier</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>fhirObservation.component<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">component</span><b> then </b>ObservationComponentFromQualifier<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">qualifier</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">component</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;qualifierComponent&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;qualifiers&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  observation.entryRelationship<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">er</span><b> then </b>ObservationCommentFromEntryRelationship<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">er</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">fhirObservation</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;comments&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
<span style="color: navy">}

</span><span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Statut CDA -&gt; Observation.status</span>
<b>group </b>ObservationStatusFromCdaStatus<span style="color: navy">(</span><b>source</b> <span style="color: maroon">statusCode</span>, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">fhirObservation</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>Observation<span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>  statusCode.code<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">code</span><b> where </b>code = 'completed'<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>fhirObservation.status = <span style="color: blue">'final'</span> <i>&quot;completed&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  statusCode.code<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">code</span><b> where </b>code = 'active'<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>fhirObservation.status = <span style="color: blue">'registered'</span> <i>&quot;active&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  statusCode.code<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">code</span><b> where </b>code = 'aborted'<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>fhirObservation.status = <span style="color: blue">'cancelled'</span> <i>&quot;aborted&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  statusCode.code<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">code</span><b> where </b>code = 'cancelled'<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>fhirObservation.status = <span style="color: blue">'cancelled'</span> <i>&quot;cancelled&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
<span style="color: navy">}

</span><span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">effectiveTime CDA -&gt; Observation.effective[x]</span>
<b>group </b>ObservationEffectiveFromEffectiveTime<span style="color: navy">(</span><b>source</b> <span style="color: maroon">effectiveTime</span>, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">fhirObservation</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>Observation<span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>  effectiveTime.value<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">value</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>fhirObservation.effective = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'dateTime'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">effectiveDateTime</span><b> then </b>TSDateTime<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">effectiveTime</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">effectiveDateTime</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;effectiveDateTime&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  effectiveTime.low<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">low</span><b> where </b>effectiveTime.high.empty()<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>fhirObservation.effective = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'dateTime'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">effectiveDateTime</span><b> then </b>TSDateTime<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">low</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">effectiveDateTime</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;effectiveLowAsDateTime&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  effectiveTime.low<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">low</span><b> where </b>effectiveTime.high.exists()<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>fhirObservation.effective = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Period'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">effectivePeriod</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    low<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>effectivePeriod.start = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'dateTime'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">start</span><b> then </b>TSDateTime<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">low</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">start</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;start&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    effectiveTime.high<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">high</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>effectivePeriod.end = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'dateTime'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">end</span><b> then </b>TSDateTime<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">high</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">end</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;end&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;effectivePeriod&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  effectiveTime<b> where </b>effectiveTime.value.empty() and effectiveTime.low.empty() and effectiveTime.high.empty()<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>fhirObservation.effective = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'dateTime'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">effectiveDateTime</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    effectiveTime<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>effectiveDateTime.extension = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Extension'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">absentReason</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      effectiveTime<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>absentReason.url = <span style="color: blue">'http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/data-absent-reason'</span> <i>&quot;url&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      effectiveTime<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>absentReason.value = <b>cast</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'unknown'</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: blue">'code'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;valueCode&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;dataAbsentReason&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;effectiveTimePresentWithoutValue&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
<span style="color: navy">}

</span><span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Valeur CDA -&gt; Observation.value[x]</span>
<b>group </b>ObservationValueFromCdaValue<span style="color: navy">(</span><b>source</b> <span style="color: maroon">value</span>, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">fhirObservation</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>Observation<span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>  value.unit<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">unit</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>fhirObservation.value = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Quantity'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">quantity</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    value.value<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">v</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>quantity.value = <b>cast</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">v</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: blue">'decimal'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;quantityValue&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    unit<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>quantity.unit = <b>cast</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">unit</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: blue">'string'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;quantityUnit&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;valueQuantity&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  value.code<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">code</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>fhirObservation.value = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'CodeableConcept'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">valueCodeableConcept</span><b> then </b>CDCodeableConcept<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">value</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">valueCodeableConcept</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;valueCodeableConcept&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  value.originalText<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">originalText</span><b> where </b>value.code.empty() and value.unit.empty()<b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    originalText.reference<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">reference</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      reference.value<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">text</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span> fhirObservation.value = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'CodeableConcept'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">valueCodeableConcept</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> valueCodeableConcept.text = <b>cast</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">text</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: blue">'string'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;valueCodeableConceptText&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;originalTextOnly&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  value.value<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">v</span><b> where </b>value.unit.empty() and value.code.empty() and (v = 'true')<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>fhirObservation.value = <b>cast</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">v</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: blue">'boolean'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;valueBooleanTrue&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  value.value<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">v</span><b> where </b>value.unit.empty() and value.code.empty() and (v = 'false')<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>fhirObservation.value = <b>cast</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">v</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: blue">'boolean'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;valueBooleanFalse&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  value.value<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">v</span><b> where </b>value.unit.empty() and value.code.empty() and (v != 'true') and (v != 'false')<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>fhirObservation.value = <b>cast</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">v</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: blue">'string'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;valueString&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
<span style="color: navy">}

</span><span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Qualifier CDA -&gt; Observation.component</span>
<b>group </b>ObservationComponentFromQualifier<span style="color: navy">(</span><b>source</b> <span style="color: maroon">qualifier</span>, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">component</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>  qualifier.name<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">name</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>component.code = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'CodeableConcept'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">componentCode</span><b> then </b>CDCodeableConcept<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">name</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">componentCode</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;componentCode&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  qualifier.value<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">value</span><b> then </b>ObservationComponentValueFromCdaValue<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">value</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">component</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;componentValue&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
<span style="color: navy">}

</span><span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Valeur CDA -&gt; Observation.component.value[x]</span>
<b>group </b>ObservationComponentValueFromCdaValue<span style="color: navy">(</span><b>source</b> <span style="color: maroon">value</span>, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">component</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>  value.unit<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">unit</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>component.value = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Quantity'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">quantity</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    value.value<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">v</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>quantity.value = <b>cast</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">v</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: blue">'decimal'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;quantityValue&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    unit<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>quantity.unit = <b>cast</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">unit</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: blue">'string'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;quantityUnit&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;componentValueQuantity&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  value.code<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">code</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>component.value = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'CodeableConcept'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">valueCodeableConcept</span><b> then </b>CDCodeableConcept<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">value</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">valueCodeableConcept</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;componentValueCodeableConcept&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  value.value<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">v</span><b> where </b>value.unit.empty() and value.code.empty() and (v = 'true')<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>component.value = <b>cast</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">v</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: blue">'boolean'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;componentValueBooleanTrue&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  value.value<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">v</span><b> where </b>value.unit.empty() and value.code.empty() and (v = 'false')<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>component.value = <b>cast</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">v</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: blue">'boolean'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;componentValueBooleanFalse&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  value.value<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">v</span><b> where </b>value.unit.empty() and value.code.empty() and (v != 'true') and (v != 'false')<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>component.value = <b>cast</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">v</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: blue">'string'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;componentValueString&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
<span style="color: navy">}

</span><span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Commentaire CDA -&gt; Observation.note</span>
<b>group </b>ObservationCommentFromEntryRelationship<span style="color: navy">(</span><b>source</b> <span style="color: maroon">er</span>, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">fhirObservation</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>Observation<span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>  er.act<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">commentAct</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    commentAct.templateId<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">tid</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      tid.root<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">root</span><b> where </b>root = '1.2.250.1.213.1.1.3.32'<b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>        commentAct.text<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">text</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>          text.reference<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">reference</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>            reference.value<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">value</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span> fhirObservation.note = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Annotation'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">note</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> note.text = <b>cast</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">value</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: blue">'string'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;note&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
          <span style="color: navy">}</span><span style="color: navy">;</span>
        <span style="color: navy">}</span><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;commentTemplate&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;commentAct&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
<span style="color: navy">}

</span><span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Panel Observation</span>
<b>group </b>PatientSummaryObservationPanelBase<span style="color: navy">(</span><b>source</b> <span style="color: maroon">organizer</span>, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">panel</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>Observation, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">patient</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>Patient<span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>  organizer<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>panel.status = <span style="color: blue">'final'</span> <i>&quot;statusDefault&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  organizer.statusCode<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">statusCode</span><b> then </b>ObservationStatusFromCdaStatus<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">statusCode</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">panel</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;status&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  organizer.id<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">id</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>panel.identifier = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Identifier'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">identifier</span><b> then </b>II<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">id</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">identifier</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;identifier&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  organizer<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span> panel.subject = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Reference'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">subjectRef</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> subjectRef.reference = <span style="color: navy">(</span>'urn:uuid:' + %patient.id<span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;subject&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  organizer<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>panel.category = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'CodeableConcept'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">category</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    organizer<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>category.coding = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Coding'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">coding</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      organizer<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>coding.system = <span style="color: blue">'http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/observation-category'</span> <i>&quot;categorySystem&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      organizer<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>coding.code = <span style="color: blue">'vital-signs'</span> <i>&quot;categoryCode&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      organizer<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>coding.display = <span style="color: blue">'Vital Signs'</span> <i>&quot;categoryDisplay&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;categoryCoding&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;category&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  organizer.code<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">code</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>panel.code = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'CodeableConcept'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">panelCode</span><b> then </b>CDCodeableConcept<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">code</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">panelCode</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  organizer.effectiveTime<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">effectiveTime</span><b> then </b>ObservationEffectiveFromEffectiveTime<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">effectiveTime</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">panel</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  organizer<b> where </b>organizer.effectiveTime.empty()<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>panel.effective = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'dateTime'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">effectiveDateTime</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    organizer<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>effectiveDateTime.extension = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Extension'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">absentReason</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      organizer<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>absentReason.url = <span style="color: blue">'http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/data-absent-reason'</span> <i>&quot;url&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      organizer<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>absentReason.value = <b>cast</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'unknown'</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: blue">'code'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;valueCode&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;dataAbsentReason&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;effectiveTimeAbsentReason&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
<span style="color: navy">}

</span><b>group </b>ObservationPanelHasMember<span style="color: navy">(</span><b>source</b> <span style="color: maroon">src</span>, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">panel</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>Observation, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">member</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>Observation<span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>  src<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span> panel.hasMember = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Reference'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">memberRef</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> memberRef.reference = <span style="color: navy">(</span>'urn:uuid:' + %member.id<span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;hasMember&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>

</span><b>group </b>ObservationAddToSection<span style="color: navy">(</span><b>source</b> <span style="color: maroon">src</span>, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">fhirObservation</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>Observation, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">compSection</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>  src<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span> compSection.entry = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Reference'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">sectionRef</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> sectionRef.reference = <span style="color: navy">(</span>'urn:uuid:' + %fhirObservation.id<span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;sectionEntry&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
<span style="color: navy">}

</span><span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">7.1 CONSTANCES / SIGNES VITAUX</span>
<b>group </b>PatientSummaryVitalSignsSection<span style="color: navy">(</span><b>source</b> <span style="color: maroon">section</span>, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">compSection</span>, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">bundle</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>Bundle, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">patient</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>Patient<span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>  section.templateId<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">sectionTid</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    sectionTid.root<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">sectionRoot</span><b> where </b>sectionRoot = '1.2.250.1.213.1.1.2.75'<b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      section.entry<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">entry</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>        entry.organizer<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">organizer</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>          organizer.templateId<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">organizerTid</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>            organizerTid.root<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">organizerRoot</span><b> where </b>organizerRoot = '1.2.250.1.213.1.1.3.49'<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span> bundle.entry<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">panelEntry</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> panelEntry.resource = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Observation'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">panel</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> panel.id = <b>uuid</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> panelEntry.fullUrl = <span style="color: navy">(</span>'urn:uuid:' + %panel.id<span style="color: navy">)</span><b> then </b>PatientSummaryVitalSignsPanelFromOrganizer<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">organizer</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">panel</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">compSection</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">bundle</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">patient</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;vitalSignsPanel&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
          <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;organizerTemplate&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
        <span style="color: navy">}</span><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      <span style="color: navy">}</span><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;vitalSignsSection&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;sectionTemplate&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
<span style="color: navy">}

</span><b>group </b>PatientSummaryVitalSignsPanelFromOrganizer<span style="color: navy">(</span><b>source</b> <span style="color: maroon">organizer</span>, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">panel</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>Observation, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">compSection</span>, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">bundle</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>Bundle, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">patient</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>Patient<span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>  organizer<b> then </b>PatientSummaryObservationPanelBase<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">organizer</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">panel</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">patient</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;panelBase&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  organizer.component<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">component</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    component.observation<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">observation</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      observation.templateId<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">obsTid</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>        obsTid.root<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">obsRoot</span><b> where </b>obsRoot = '1.2.250.1.213.1.1.3.50'<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span> bundle.entry<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">observationEntry</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> observationEntry.resource = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Observation'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">fhirObservation</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> fhirObservation.id = <b>uuid</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> observationEntry.fullUrl = <span style="color: navy">(</span>'urn:uuid:' + %fhirObservation.id<span style="color: navy">)</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>          observation<b> then </b>PatientSummaryVitalSignObservationFromObservation<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">observation</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">fhirObservation</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">patient</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;vitalSignObservation&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
          observation<b> then </b>ObservationPanelHasMember<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">observation</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">panel</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">fhirObservation</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;hasMember&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
        <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;memberObservation&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;observationTemplate&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  organizer<b> then </b>ObservationAddToSection<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">organizer</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">panel</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">compSection</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;sectionEntry&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
<span style="color: navy">}

</span><b>group </b>PatientSummaryVitalSignObservationFromObservation<span style="color: navy">(</span><b>source</b> <span style="color: maroon">observation</span>, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">fhirObservation</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>Observation, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">patient</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>Patient<span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>  observation<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>fhirObservation.status = <span style="color: blue">'final'</span> <i>&quot;statusDefault&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  observation.statusCode<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">statusCode</span><b> then </b>ObservationStatusFromCdaStatus<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">statusCode</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">fhirObservation</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;status&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  observation.id<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">id</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>fhirObservation.identifier = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Identifier'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">identifier</span><b> then </b>II<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">id</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">identifier</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;identifier&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  observation<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span> fhirObservation.subject = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Reference'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">subjectRef</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> subjectRef.reference = <span style="color: navy">(</span>'urn:uuid:' + %patient.id<span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;subject&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  observation<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>fhirObservation.category = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'CodeableConcept'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">category</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    observation<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>category.coding = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Coding'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">coding</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      observation<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>coding.system = <span style="color: blue">'http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/observation-category'</span> <i>&quot;categorySystem&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      observation<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>coding.code = <span style="color: blue">'vital-signs'</span> <i>&quot;categoryCode&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      observation<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>coding.display = <span style="color: blue">'Vital Signs'</span> <i>&quot;categoryDisplay&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;categoryCoding&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;category&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>

</span><span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Valeur spécifique des signes vitaux</span>

</span>  value.unit<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">unit</span><b> where </b>(unit = 'm') and (observation.code.code = '8302-2')<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>fhirObservation.value = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Quantity'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">quantity</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {

    unit<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>quantity.code = <span style="color: blue">'cm'</span> <i>&quot;heightCodeCm&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>

  value.unit<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">unit</span><b> where </b>(observation.code.code != '8302-2') or (unit != 'm')<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>fhirObservation.value = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Quantity'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">quantity</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    value.value<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">v</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>quantity.value = <b>cast</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">v</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: blue">'decimal'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;quantityValue&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    unit<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>quantity.unit = <b>cast</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">unit</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: blue">'string'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;quantityUnit&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    value<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>quantity.system = <span style="color: blue">'http://unitsofmeasure.org'</span> <i>&quot;quantitySystem&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>

  value.code<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">code</span><b> where </b>value.unit.empty()<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>fhirObservation.value = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'CodeableConcept'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">valueCodeableConcept</span><b> then </b>CDCodeableConcept<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">value</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">valueCodeableConcept</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;valueCodeableConcept&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>

    unit<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>quantity.unit = <b>cast</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">unit</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: blue">'string'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;quantityUnit&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>

      value.high<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">high</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>fhirReferenceRange.high = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Quantity'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">highQuantity</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {

      observation<b> then </b>ObservationAddToSection<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">observation</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">fhirObservation</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">compSection</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;sectionEntry&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;directObservation&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    entry.organizer<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">organizer</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {

</span>          observation<b> then </b>PatientSummaryProfessionalRiskObservationFromObservation<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">observation</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">fhirObservation</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">patient</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;professionalRiskComponentObservation&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
          observation<b> then </b>ObservationAddToSection<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">observation</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">fhirObservation</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">compSection</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;sectionEntry&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
        <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;componentObservation&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>

</span><b>group </b>PatientSummaryProfessionalRiskObservationFromObservation<span style="color: navy">(</span><b>source</b> <span style="color: maroon">observation</span>, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">fhirObservation</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>Observation, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">patient</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>Patient<span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>  observation<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>fhirObservation.status = <span style="color: blue">'final'</span> <i>&quot;statusDefault&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>

  observation<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>fhirObservation.category = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'CodeableConcept'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">category</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {

      observation<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>coding.code = <span style="color: blue">'social-history'</span> <i>&quot;categoryCode&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>

    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;categoryCoding&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;category&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  observation.code<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">code</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>fhirObservation.code = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'CodeableConcept'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">obsCode</span><b> then </b>CDCodeableConcept<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">code</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">obsCode</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  observation.code<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">code</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {

  observation.text<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">text</span><b> then </b>ProfessionalRiskObservationNoteFromText<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">text</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">fhirObservation</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;textNote&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  observation.effectiveTime<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">effectiveTime</span><b> then </b>ObservationEffectiveFromEffectiveTime<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">effectiveTime</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">fhirObservation</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  observation<b> where </b>observation.effectiveTime.empty()<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>fhirObservation.effective = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'dateTime'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">effectiveDateTime</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {

  observation.value<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">value</span><b> then </b>ProfessionalRiskObservationValueFromCdaValue<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">value</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">fhirObservation</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy">;</span>

  observation.methodCode<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">methodCode</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>fhirObservation.method = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'CodeableConcept'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">method</span><b> then </b>CDCodeableConcept<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">methodCode</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">method</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;method&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>

  observation.entryRelationship<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">er</span><b> then </b>ObservationCommentFromEntryRelationship<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">er</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">fhirObservation</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;comments&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>

  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;valueQuantity&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  value.code<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">code</span><b> where </b>value.unit.empty()<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>fhirObservation.value = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'CodeableConcept'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">valueCodeableConcept</span><b> then </b>CDCodeableConcept<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">value</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">valueCodeableConcept</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;valueCodeableConcept&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  value.value<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">v</span><b> where </b>value.unit.empty() and value.code.empty() and (v = 'true')<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>fhirObservation.value = <b>cast</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">v</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: blue">'boolean'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;valueBooleanTrue&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  value.value<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">v</span><b> where </b>value.unit.empty() and value.code.empty() and (v = 'false')<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>fhirObservation.value = <b>cast</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">v</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: blue">'boolean'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;valueBooleanFalse&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>

</span>  qualifier.name<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">name</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>component.code = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'CodeableConcept'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">componentCode</span><b> then </b>CDCodeableConcept<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">name</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">componentCode</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;componentCode&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  qualifier.value<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">value</span><b> then </b>ProfessionalRiskObservationComponentValueFromCdaValue<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">value</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">component</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;componentValue&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>

</span><b>group </b>ProfessionalRiskObservationComponentValueFromCdaValue<span style="color: navy">(</span><b>source</b> <span style="color: maroon">value</span>, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">component</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy"> {

  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;componentValueQuantity&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  value.code<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">code</span><b> where </b>value.unit.empty()<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>component.value = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'CodeableConcept'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">valueCodeableConcept</span><b> then </b>CDCodeableConcept<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">value</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">valueCodeableConcept</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;componentValueCodeableConcept&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  value.value<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">v</span><b> where </b>value.unit.empty() and value.code.empty() and (v = 'true')<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>component.value = <b>cast</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">v</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: blue">'boolean'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;componentValueBooleanTrue&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>

</span><b>group </b>ProfessionalRiskObservationNoteFromText<span style="color: navy">(</span><b>source</b> <span style="color: maroon">text</span>, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">fhirObservation</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>Observation<span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy"> {

  <span style="color: navy">}</span><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  text.xmlText<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">xml</span><b> where </b>text.reference.empty()<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span> fhirObservation.note = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Annotation'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">note</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> note.text = <b>cast</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">xml</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: blue">'string'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;noteText&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>

</span><span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">8. PLAN DE SOINS</span>
<b>group </b>PatientSummaryCarePlanSection<span style="color: navy">(</span><b>source</b> <span style="color: maroon">section</span>, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">compSection</span>, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">bundle</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>Bundle, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">patient</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>Patient<span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">CarePlan.</span>
  section<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span> bundle.entry<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">carePlanEntry</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> carePlanEntry.resource = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'CarePlan'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">carePlan</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> carePlan.id = <b>uuid</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> carePlanEntry.fullUrl = <span style="color: navy">(</span>'urn:uuid:' + %carePlan.id<span style="color: navy">)</span><b> then </b>PSPlanCarePlan<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">section</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">carePlan</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">compSection</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">bundle</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">patient</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;carePlan&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
<span style="color: navy">}

</span><b>group </b>PSPlanCarePlan<span style="color: navy">(</span><b>source</b> <span style="color: maroon">section</span>, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">carePlan</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>CarePlan, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">compSection</span>, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">bundle</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>Bundle, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">patient</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>Patient<span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Statut.</span>
  section<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>carePlan.status = <span style="color: blue">'active'</span> <i>&quot;status&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Intention.</span>
  section<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>carePlan.intent = <span style="color: blue">'plan'</span> <i>&quot;intent&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Patient.</span>
  section<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span> carePlan.subject = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Reference'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">subjectRef</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> subjectRef.reference = <span style="color: navy">(</span>'urn:uuid:' + %patient.id<span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;subject&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Identifiant.</span>
  section.id<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">id</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>carePlan.identifier = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Identifier'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">identifier</span><b> then </b>II<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">id</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">identifier</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;identifier&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Catégorie.</span>
  section.code<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">code</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>carePlan.category = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'CodeableConcept'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">category</span><b> then </b>CDCodeableConcept<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">code</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">category</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;category&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Titre.</span>
  section.title<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">title</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>carePlan.title = <span style="color: navy">(</span>title.xmlText<span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Période.</span>
  section.effectiveTime<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">effectiveTime</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    effectiveTime.value<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">value</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>carePlan.created = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'dateTime'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">created</span><b> then </b>TSDateTime<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">effectiveTime</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">created</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;created&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    effectiveTime.low<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">low</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>carePlan.period = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Period'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">period</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      low<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>period.start = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'dateTime'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">start</span><b> then </b>TSDateTime<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">low</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">start</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;start&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      effectiveTime.high<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">high</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>period.end = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'dateTime'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">end</span><b> then </b>TSDateTime<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">high</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">end</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;end&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;period&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Entrées du plan.</span>
  section.entry<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">sectionEntry</span><b> then </b>PSPlanEntryDispatcher<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">sectionEntry</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">carePlan</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">compSection</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">bundle</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">patient</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;entries&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Référence section.</span>
  section<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span> compSection.entry = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Reference'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">sectionRef</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> sectionRef.reference = <span style="color: navy">(</span>'urn:uuid:' + %carePlan.id<span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;sectionEntryCarePlan&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>

</span><b>group </b>PSPlanEntryDispatcher<span style="color: navy">(</span><b>source</b> <span style="color: maroon">sectionEntry</span>, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">carePlan</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>CarePlan, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">compSection</span>, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">bundle</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>Bundle, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">patient</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>Patient<span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy"> {

  sectionEntry.substanceAdministration<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">sa</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    sa.templateId<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">tid</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      tid.root<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">root</span><b> where </b>root = '1.2.250.1.213.1.1.3.42'<b> then </b>PSPlanMedicationRequestEntry<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">sa</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">carePlan</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">compSection</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">bundle</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">patient</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;medicationRequest&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;templateTreatment&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;treatment&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Demande d’examen.</span>
  sectionEntry.observation<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">obs</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
