</span>      tid.root<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">root</span><b> where </b>root = '1.2.250.1.213.1.1.3.27'<b> then </b>PSPlanServiceRequestEntry<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">obs</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">carePlan</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">compSection</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">bundle</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">patient</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;serviceRequest&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;templateServiceRequest&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;serviceRequest&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Acte prévu.</span>
  sectionEntry.procedure<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">proc</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    proc.templateId<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">tid</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      tid.root<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">root</span><b> where </b>root = '1.2.250.1.213.1.1.3.62'<b> then </b>PSPlanProcedureEntry<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">proc</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">carePlan</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">compSection</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">bundle</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">patient</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;procedure&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;templateProcedure&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Rencontre prévue.</span>
  sectionEntry.encounter<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">enc</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    enc.templateId<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">tid</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      tid.root<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">root</span><b> where </b>root = '1.2.250.1.213.1.1.3.58'<b> then </b>PSPlanEncounterEntry<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">enc</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">carePlan</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">compSection</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">bundle</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">patient</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;encounter&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;templateEncounter&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Vaccin recommandé.</span>
  sectionEntry.substanceAdministration<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">sa</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    sa.templateId<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">tid</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      tid.root<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">root</span><b> where </b>root = '1.2.250.1.213.1.1.3.47'<b> then </b>PSPlanImmunizationRecommendationEntry<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">sa</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">carePlan</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">compSection</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">bundle</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">patient</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;immunizationRecommendation&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;templateVaccineRecommendation&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>

</span><span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">TRAITEMENT PRÉVU -&gt; MedicationRequest</span>
<b>group </b>PSPlanMedicationRequestEntry<span style="color: navy">(</span><b>source</b> <span style="color: maroon">sa</span>, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">carePlan</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>CarePlan, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">compSection</span>, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">bundle</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>Bundle, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">patient</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>Patient<span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy"> {

  sa<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span> bundle.entry<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">medicationRequestEntry</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> medicationRequestEntry.resource = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'MedicationRequest'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">medicationRequest</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> medicationRequest.id = <b>uuid</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> medicationRequestEntry.fullUrl = <span style="color: navy">(</span>'urn:uuid:' + %medicationRequest.id<span style="color: navy">)</span><b> then </b>PSPlanMedicationRequest<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">sa</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">medicationRequest</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">carePlan</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">compSection</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">bundle</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">patient</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;medicationRequest&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>

</span><b>group </b>PSPlanMedicationRequest<span style="color: navy">(</span><b>source</b> <span style="color: maroon">sa</span>, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">medicationRequest</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>MedicationRequest, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">carePlan</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>CarePlan, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">compSection</span>, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">bundle</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>Bundle, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">patient</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>Patient<span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Statut.</span>
  sa<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>medicationRequest.status = <span style="color: blue">'active'</span> <i>&quot;statusDefault&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  sa.statusCode<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">statusCode</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    statusCode.code<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">code</span><b> where </b>code = 'active'<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>medicationRequest.status = <span style="color: blue">'active'</span> <i>&quot;active&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    statusCode.code<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">code</span><b> where </b>code = 'completed'<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>medicationRequest.status = <span style="color: blue">'completed'</span> <i>&quot;completed&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    statusCode.code<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">code</span><b> where </b>code = 'aborted'<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>medicationRequest.status = <span style="color: blue">'stopped'</span> <i>&quot;aborted&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    statusCode.code<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">code</span><b> where </b>code = 'cancelled'<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>medicationRequest.status = <span style="color: blue">'cancelled'</span> <i>&quot;cancelled&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    statusCode.code<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">code</span><b> where </b>code = 'suspended'<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>medicationRequest.status = <span style="color: blue">'on-hold'</span> <i>&quot;suspended&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;status&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Intention.</span>
  sa<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>medicationRequest.intent = <span style="color: blue">'plan'</span> <i>&quot;intentDefault&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  sa.moodCode<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">moodCode</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    moodCode<b> where </b>moodCode = 'INT'<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>medicationRequest.intent = <span style="color: blue">'plan'</span> <i>&quot;intent&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    moodCode<b> where </b>moodCode = 'GOL'<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>medicationRequest.intent = <span style="color: blue">'plan'</span> <i>&quot;goal&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    moodCode<b> where </b>moodCode = 'PRP'<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>medicationRequest.intent = <span style="color: blue">'proposal'</span> <i>&quot;proposal&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    moodCode<b> where </b>moodCode = 'RQO'<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>medicationRequest.intent = <span style="color: blue">'order'</span> <i>&quot;order&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    moodCode<b> where </b>moodCode = 'ARQ'<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>medicationRequest.intent = <span style="color: blue">'order'</span> <i>&quot;appointmentRequest&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;intent&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Identifiant.</span>
  sa.id<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">id</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>medicationRequest.identifier = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Identifier'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">identifier</span><b> then </b>II<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">id</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">identifier</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;identifier&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Patient.</span>
  sa<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span> medicationRequest.subject = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Reference'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">subjectRef</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> subjectRef.reference = <span style="color: navy">(</span>'urn:uuid:' + %patient.id<span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;subject&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Médicament.</span>
  sa.consumable<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">consumable</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    consumable.manufacturedProduct<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">manufacturedProduct</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      manufacturedProduct.manufacturedMaterial<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">material</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>        <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Médicament codé.</span>
        material.code<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">medicationCode</span><b> where </b>medicationCode.code.empty().not()<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span> bundle.entry<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">medicationEntry</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> medicationEntry.resource = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Medication'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">medication</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> medication.id = <b>uuid</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> medicationEntry.fullUrl = <span style="color: navy">(</span>'urn:uuid:' + %medication.id<span style="color: navy">)</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>          material.code<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">code</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>medication.code = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'CodeableConcept'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">medicationCodeableConcept</span><b> then </b>CDCodeableConcept<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">code</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">medicationCodeableConcept</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;medicationCode&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
          material.name<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">name</span><b> where </b>material.code.empty()<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>medication.code = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'CodeableConcept'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">codeOnlyText</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>            name.xmlText<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">nameText</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>codeOnlyText.text = <b>cast</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">nameText</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: blue">'string'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;nameText&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
          <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;nameOnly&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
          material<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span> medicationRequest.medication = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Reference'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">medicationRef</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> medicationRef.reference = <span style="color: navy">(</span>'urn:uuid:' + %medication.id<span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;medicationReference&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
        <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;codedMedication&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
        <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Médicament textuel.</span>
        material.code<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">medicationCode</span><b> where </b>medicationCode.code.empty()<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>medicationRequest.medication = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'CodeableConcept'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">medicationCodeableConcept</span><b> then </b>CDCodeableConcept<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">medicationCode</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">medicationCodeableConcept</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;textOnlyMedication&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
        <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Nom du médicament.</span>
        material.name<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">name</span><b> where </b>material.code.empty()<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>medicationRequest.medication = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'CodeableConcept'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">medicationCodeableConcept</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>          name.xmlText<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">nameText</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>medicationCodeableConcept.text = <b>cast</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">nameText</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: blue">'string'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;medicationNameOnly&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
        <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;medicationNameOnly&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
        <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Traduction.</span>
        material.code<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">medicationCode</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>          medicationCode.translation<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">translation</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>medicationRequest.medication = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'CodeableConcept'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">medicationCodeableConcept</span><b> then </b>CDCodeableConcept<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">translation</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">medicationCodeableConcept</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;translationMedication&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
        <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;translation&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;material&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;medication&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Médicament absent.</span>
  sa<b> where </b>sa.consumable.empty()<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>medicationRequest.medication = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'CodeableConcept'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">medicationAbsent</span><b> then </b>PSPlanCodeableConceptAbsentReason<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">sa</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">medicationAbsent</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;medicationAbsent&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Note.</span>
  sa.text<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">text</span><b> then </b>PSPlanTextToNote<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">text</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">medicationRequest</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Commentaire.</span>
  sa.entryRelationship<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">er</span><b> then </b>PSPlanCommentToNote<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">er</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">medicationRequest</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;comment&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Timing.</span>
  sa.effectiveTime<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">effectiveTime</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    effectiveTime.low<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">low</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>medicationRequest.dosageInstruction<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">dosage</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      low<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>dosage.timing<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">timing</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>        low<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>timing.repeat<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">repeat</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>          low<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>repeat.bounds = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Period'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">period</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>            low<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>period.start = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'dateTime'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">start</span><b> then </b>TSDateTime<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">low</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">start</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;start&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
            effectiveTime.high<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">high</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>period.end = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'dateTime'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">end</span><b> then </b>TSDateTime<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">high</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">end</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;end&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
          <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;bounds&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
        <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;repeat&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;timing&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;lowHigh&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    effectiveTime.period<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">period</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>medicationRequest.dosageInstruction<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">dosage</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      period<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>dosage.timing<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">timing</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {

          period.unit<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">unit</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>repeat.periodUnit = <b>cast</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">unit</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: blue">'code'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;periodUnit&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
        <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;repeat&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;timing&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;frequency&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;timing&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Répétitions.</span>
  sa.repeatNumber<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">repeatNumber</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {

    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;dispenseRequest&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span><span style="color: navy">;</span>

  sa.routeCode<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">routeCode</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>medicationRequest.dosageInstruction<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">dosage</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    routeCode<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>dosage.route = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'CodeableConcept'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">route</span><b> then </b>CDCodeableConcept<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">routeCode</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">route</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;route&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;route&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>

  sa.approachSiteCode<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">siteCode</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>medicationRequest.dosageInstruction<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">dosage</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {

  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;site&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>

  sa.doseQuantity<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">doseQuantity</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    doseQuantity.low<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">low</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>medicationRequest.dosageInstruction<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">dosage</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      doseQuantity<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span> dosage.doseAndRate<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">doseAndRate</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> doseAndRate.dose = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Range'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">doseRange</span><b> then </b>MedicationRangeFromLowHigh<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">doseQuantity</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">doseRange</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;doseRange&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;dose&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Débit.</span>
  sa.rateQuantity<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">rateQuantity</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    rateQuantity.low<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">low</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>medicationRequest.dosageInstruction<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">dosage</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      rateQuantity<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span> dosage.doseAndRate<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">doseAndRate</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> doseAndRate.rate = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Range'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">rateRange</span><b> then </b>MedicationRangeFromLowHigh<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">rateQuantity</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">rateRange</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;rateRange&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;rate&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span><span style="color: navy">;</span>

  <span style="color: navy">}</span><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Lien CarePlan.</span>
  sa<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span> carePlan.supportingInfo = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Reference'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">supportRef</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> supportRef.reference = <span style="color: navy">(</span>'urn:uuid:' + %medicationRequest.id<span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;supportingInfo&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>

</span><span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">DEMANDE D’EXAMEN OU DE SUIVI -&gt; ServiceRequest</span>
<b>group </b>PSPlanServiceRequestEntry<span style="color: navy">(</span><b>source</b> <span style="color: maroon">obs</span>, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">carePlan</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>CarePlan, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">compSection</span>, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">bundle</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>Bundle, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">patient</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>Patient<span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">ServiceRequest.</span>
  obs<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span> bundle.entry<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">serviceRequestEntry</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> serviceRequestEntry.resource = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'ServiceRequest'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">serviceRequest</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> serviceRequest.id = <b>uuid</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> serviceRequestEntry.fullUrl = <span style="color: navy">(</span>'urn:uuid:' + %serviceRequest.id<span style="color: navy">)</span><b> then </b>PSPlanServiceRequest<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">obs</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">serviceRequest</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">carePlan</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">compSection</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">patient</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;serviceRequest&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
<span style="color: navy">}

</span><b>group </b>PSPlanServiceRequest<span style="color: navy">(</span><b>source</b> <span style="color: maroon">obs</span>, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">serviceRequest</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>ServiceRequest, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">carePlan</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>CarePlan, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">compSection</span>, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">patient</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>Patient<span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Statut.</span>
  obs<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>serviceRequest.status = <span style="color: blue">'active'</span> <i>&quot;statusDefault&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  obs.statusCode<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">statusCode</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    statusCode.code<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">code</span><b> where </b>code = 'active'<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>serviceRequest.status = <span style="color: blue">'active'</span> <i>&quot;active&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    statusCode.code<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">code</span><b> where </b>code = 'completed'<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>serviceRequest.status = <span style="color: blue">'completed'</span> <i>&quot;completed&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    statusCode.code<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">code</span><b> where </b>code = 'aborted'<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>serviceRequest.status = <span style="color: blue">'revoked'</span> <i>&quot;aborted&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    statusCode.code<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">code</span><b> where </b>code = 'cancelled'<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>serviceRequest.status = <span style="color: blue">'revoked'</span> <i>&quot;cancelled&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    statusCode.code<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">code</span><b> where </b>code = 'suspended'<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>serviceRequest.status = <span style="color: blue">'on-hold'</span> <i>&quot;suspended&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;status&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Intention.</span>
  obs<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>serviceRequest.intent = <span style="color: blue">'plan'</span> <i>&quot;intentDefault&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  obs.moodCode<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">moodCode</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    moodCode<b> where </b>moodCode = 'INT'<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>serviceRequest.intent = <span style="color: blue">'plan'</span> <i>&quot;intent&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    moodCode<b> where </b>moodCode = 'GOL'<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>serviceRequest.intent = <span style="color: blue">'plan'</span> <i>&quot;goal&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    moodCode<b> where </b>moodCode = 'PRP'<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>serviceRequest.intent = <span style="color: blue">'proposal'</span> <i>&quot;proposal&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    moodCode<b> where </b>moodCode = 'RQO'<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>serviceRequest.intent = <span style="color: blue">'order'</span> <i>&quot;order&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    moodCode<b> where </b>moodCode = 'ARQ'<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>serviceRequest.intent = <span style="color: blue">'order'</span> <i>&quot;appointmentRequest&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;intent&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Identifiant.</span>
  obs.id<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">id</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>serviceRequest.identifier = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Identifier'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">identifier</span><b> then </b>II<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">id</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">identifier</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;identifier&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Patient.</span>
  obs<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span> serviceRequest.subject = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Reference'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">subjectRef</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> subjectRef.reference = <span style="color: navy">(</span>'urn:uuid:' + %patient.id<span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;subject&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Code.</span>
  obs.code<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">code</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>serviceRequest.code = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'CodeableConcept'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">codeableConcept</span><b> then </b>CDCodeableConcept<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">code</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">codeableConcept</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Note.</span>
  obs.text<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">text</span><b> then </b>PSPlanTextToNote<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">text</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">serviceRequest</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Commentaire.</span>
  obs.entryRelationship<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">er</span><b> then </b>PSPlanCommentToNote<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">er</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">serviceRequest</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;comment&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Période.</span>
  obs.effectiveTime<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">effectiveTime</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    effectiveTime.value<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">value</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>serviceRequest.occurrence = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'dateTime'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">occurrenceDateTime</span><b> then </b>TSDateTime<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">effectiveTime</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">occurrenceDateTime</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;dateTime&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    effectiveTime.low<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">low</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>serviceRequest.occurrence = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Period'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">period</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      low<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>period.start = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'dateTime'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">start</span><b> then </b>TSDateTime<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">low</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">start</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;start&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      effectiveTime.high<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">high</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>period.end = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'dateTime'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">end</span><b> then </b>TSDateTime<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">high</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">end</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;end&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;period&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;occurrence&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Détail.</span>
  obs.value<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">value</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>serviceRequest.orderDetail = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'CodeableConcept'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">orderDetail</span><b> then </b>CDCodeableConcept<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">value</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">orderDetail</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;orderDetail&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>

</span><b>group </b>PSPlanProcedure<span style="color: navy">(</span><b>source</b> <span style="color: maroon">proc</span>, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">fhirProcedure</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>Procedure, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">carePlan</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>CarePlan, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">compSection</span>, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">patient</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>Patient<span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy"> {

      effectiveTime.high<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">high</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>period.end = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'dateTime'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">end</span><b> then </b>TSDateTime<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">high</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">end</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;end&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>

  proc.approachSiteCode<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">approachSiteCode</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>fhirProcedure.bodySite = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'CodeableConcept'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">bodySite</span><b> then </b>CDCodeableConcept<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">approachSiteCode</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">bodySite</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;approachSite&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Lien CarePlan.</span>

    <span style="color: navy">}</span><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    effectiveTime.low<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">low</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>plannedEncounter.period = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Period'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">period</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {

      <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Participant avec rôle.</span>

</span>        assignedEntity<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span> participant.individual = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Reference'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">individualRef</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> individualRef.reference = <span style="color: navy">(</span>'urn:uuid:' + %practitionerRole.id<span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;roleRef&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;participantRole&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>

    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;participantPractitioner&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>

<b>group </b>PSPlanImmunizationRecommendationEntry<span style="color: navy">(</span><b>source</b> <span style="color: maroon">sa</span>, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">carePlan</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>CarePlan, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">compSection</span>, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">bundle</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>Bundle, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">patient</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>Patient<span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy"> {

</span><b>group </b>PSPlanImmunizationRecommendation<span style="color: navy">(</span><b>source</b> <span style="color: maroon">sa</span>, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">recommendation</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>ImmunizationRecommendation, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">carePlan</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>CarePlan, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">compSection</span>, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">patient</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>Patient<span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy"> {

  sa.id<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">id</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>recommendation.identifier = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Identifier'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">identifier</span><b> then </b>II<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">id</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">identifier</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;identifier&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>

  sa<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span> recommendation.patient = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Reference'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">patientRef</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> patientRef.reference = <span style="color: navy">(</span>'urn:uuid:' + %patient.id<span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;patient&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Date.</span>
  sa.effectiveTime<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">effectiveTime</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    effectiveTime.value<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">value</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>recommendation.date = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'dateTime'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">recommendationDate</span><b> then </b>TSDateTime<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">effectiveTime</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">recommendationDate</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;dateValue&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    effectiveTime.low<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">low</span><b> where </b>effectiveTime.value.empty()<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>recommendation.date = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'dateTime'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">recommendationDate</span><b> then </b>TSDateTime<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">low</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">recommendationDate</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;dateLow&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    effectiveTime.high<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">high</span><b> where </b>effectiveTime.value.empty() and effectiveTime.low.empty()<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>recommendation.date = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'dateTime'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">recommendationDate</span><b> then </b>TSDateTime<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">high</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">recommendationDate</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;dateHigh&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    effectiveTime<b> where </b>effectiveTime.value.empty() and effectiveTime.low.empty() and effectiveTime.high.empty()<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>recommendation.date = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'dateTime'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">recommendationDate</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      effectiveTime<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>recommendationDate.extension = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Extension'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">absentReason</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>        effectiveTime<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>absentReason.url = <span style="color: blue">'http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/data-absent-reason'</span> <i>&quot;url&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
        effectiveTime<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>absentReason.value = <b>cast</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'unknown'</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: blue">'code'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;valueCode&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;dataAbsentReason&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;datePresentWithoutValue&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;recommendationDate&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Date absente.</span>
  sa<b> where </b>sa.effectiveTime.empty()<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>recommendation.date = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'dateTime'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">recommendationDate</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    sa<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>recommendationDate.extension = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Extension'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">absentReason</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      sa<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>absentReason.url = <span style="color: blue">'http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/data-absent-reason'</span> <i>&quot;url&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      sa<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>absentReason.value = <b>cast</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'unknown'</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: blue">'code'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;valueCode&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;dataAbsentReason&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;recommendationDateAbsentReason&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Recommandation.</span>
  sa<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>recommendation.recommendation<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">rec</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Statut prévisionnel.</span>
    sa.statusCode<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">statusCode</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      statusCode.code<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">code</span><b> where </b>code = 'active'<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>rec.forecastStatus = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'CodeableConcept'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">forecastStatus</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {

</span>                  commentAct.text<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">text</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>                    text.reference<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">reference</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>                      reference.value<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">value</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span> condition.note = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Annotation'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">note</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> note.text = <b>cast</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">value</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: blue">'string'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;commentReference&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
                    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;commentTextReference&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
                    text.xmlText<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">xml</span><b> where </b>text.reference.empty()<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span> condition.note = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Annotation'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">note</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> note.text = <b>cast</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">xml</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: blue">'string'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;commentText&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
                  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;commentText&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
                <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;comment&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
              <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;commentTemplate&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
            <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;commentAct&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
          <span style="color: navy">}</span><span style="color: navy">;</span>
        <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;condition&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;components&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Référence section.</span>
      familyOrganizer<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span> compSection.entry = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Reference'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">sectionRef</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> sectionRef.reference = <span style="color: navy">(</span>'urn:uuid:' + %familyHistory.id<span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;sectionEntry&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;familyHistory&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;sectionEntry&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
<span style="color: navy">}

</span></pre></div>

  <import
          value="https://interop.esante.gouv.fr/ig/fhir/mappingcdafhir/StructureMap/CdaToFHIRTypes|0.1.0"/>
  <import
          value="https://interop.esante.gouv.fr/ig/fhir/mappingcdafhir/StructureMap/CdaToBundle"/>
  <import
          value="https://interop.esante.gouv.fr/ig/fhir/mappingcdafhir/StructureMap/CdaFrToBundle|0.1.0"/>
  <group>
    <name value="TransformPatientSummaryClinicalDocumentToFHIRDocument"/>
    <typeMode value="none"/>
    <documentation
                   value="GROUPE D’ENTRÉE — CRÉATION DU BUNDLE FINAL PATIENT SUMMARY

   Ce groupe crée le Bundle final avec Composition et Patient. Ces ressources
   sont toujours nécessaires dans un document FHIR de type document.

   Les autres ressources administratives sont créées plus loin, uniquement si le
   bloc CDA correspondant existe"/>
    <input>
      <name value="cda"/>
      <type value="ClinicalDocument"/>
      <mode value="source"/>
    </input>
    <input>
      <name value="bundle"/>
      <type value="Bundle"/>
      <mode value="target"/>
    </input>
    <rule>
      <name value="main"/>
      <source>
        <context value="cda"/>
      </source>
      <target>
        <context value="bundle"/>
        <contextType value="variable"/>
        <element value="entry"/>
        <variable value="compositionEntry"/>
      </target>
      <target>
        <context value="compositionEntry"/>
        <contextType value="variable"/>
        <element value="resource"/>
        <variable value="composition"/>
        <transform value="create"/>
        <parameter>
          <valueString value="Composition"/>
        </parameter>
      </target>
      <target>
        <context value="composition"/>
        <contextType value="variable"/>
        <element value="id"/>
        <transform value="uuid"/>
      </target>
      <target>
        <context value="compositionEntry"/>
        <contextType value="variable"/>
        <element value="fullUrl"/>
        <transform value="evaluate"/>
        <parameter>
          <valueString value="'urn:uuid:' + %composition.id"/>
        </parameter>
      </target>
      <target>
        <context value="bundle"/>
        <contextType value="variable"/>
        <element value="entry"/>
        <variable value="patientEntry"/>
      </target>
      <target>
        <context value="patientEntry"/>
        <contextType value="variable"/>
        <element value="resource"/>
        <variable value="patient"/>
        <transform value="create"/>
        <parameter>
          <valueString value="Patient"/>
        </parameter>
      </target>
      <target>
        <context value="patient"/>
        <contextType value="variable"/>
        <element value="id"/>
        <transform value="uuid"/>
      </target>
      <target>
        <context value="patientEntry"/>
        <contextType value="variable"/>
        <element value="fullUrl"/>
        <transform value="evaluate"/>
        <parameter>
          <valueString value="'urn:uuid:' + %patient.id"/>
        </parameter>
      </target>
      <dependent>
        <name value="OrchestrateClinicalDocumentFinalTransformation"/>
        <variable value="cda"/>
        <variable value="patient"/>
        <variable value="composition"/>
        <variable value="bundle"/>
      </dependent>
    </rule>
  </group>
  <group>
    <name value="OrchestrateClinicalDocumentFinalTransformation"/>
    <typeMode value="none"/>
    <documentation
                   value="GROUPE D’ORCHESTRATION FINALE — SOCLE FRANÇAIS + MÉTIER PATIENT SUMMARY
   Ce groupe applique deux traitements successifs :
   - MapClinicalDocumentHeaderWithFrenchRules, importé depuis l’étape 3, traite
     l’en-tête CDA, crée les ressources administratives nécessaires, applique le
     socle générique de l’étape 2 et l’enrichissement français ;
   - MapPatientSummaryBody traite ensuite les sections Patient Summary et crée
     les ressources métier à partir des entries CDA.

   Les ressources optionnelles ne sont donc pas créées au début : elles sont
   créées uniquement dans les groupes associés aux blocs CDA présents"/>
    <input>
      <name value="cda"/>
      <type value="ClinicalDocument"/>
      <mode value="source"/>
    </input>
    <input>
      <name value="patient"/>
      <type value="Patient"/>
      <mode value="target"/>
    </input>
    <input>
      <name value="composition"/>
      <type value="Composition"/>
      <mode value="target"/>
    </input>
    <input>
      <name value="bundle"/>
      <type value="Bundle"/>
      <mode value="target"/>
    </input>
    <rule>
      <name value="headerFrenchBase"/>
      <source>
        <context value="cda"/>
      </source>
      <dependent>
        <name value="MapClinicalDocumentHeaderWithFrenchRules"/>
        <variable value="cda"/>
        <variable value="bundle"/>
        <variable value="composition"/>
        <variable value="patient"/>
      </dependent>
    </rule>
    <rule>
      <name value="patientSummaryBody"/>
      <source>
        <context value="cda"/>
      </source>
      <dependent>
        <name value="MapPatientSummaryBody"/>
        <variable value="cda"/>
        <variable value="composition"/>
        <variable value="bundle"/>
        <variable value="patient"/>
      </dependent>
    </rule>
  </group>
  <group>
    <name value="MapPatientSummaryBody"/>
    <typeMode value="none"/>
    <documentation
                   value="CORPS PATIENT SUMMARY — SECTIONS + ENTRIES MÉTIER
   Pour chaque section CDA :
   - MapCDASectionToCompositionSection, importé depuis l’étape 2, crée le
     squelette commun de la Composition.section avec title, code et text ;
   - MapPatientSummarySectionEntries crée ensuite les ressources métier selon
     le code LOINC de la section"/>
    <input>
      <name value="src"/>
      <type value="ClinicalDocument"/>
      <mode value="source"/>
    </input>
    <input>
      <name value="composition"/>
      <type value="Composition"/>
      <mode value="target"/>
    </input>
    <input>
      <name value="bundle"/>
      <type value="Bundle"/>
      <mode value="target"/>
    </input>
    <input>
      <name value="patient"/>
      <type value="Patient"/>
      <mode value="target"/>
    </input>
    <rule>
      <name value="component"/>
      <source>
        <context value="src"/>
        <element value="component"/>
        <variable value="cdaComponent"/>
      </source>
      <rule>
        <name value="structuredBody"/>
        <source>
          <context value="cdaComponent"/>
          <element value="structuredBody"/>
          <variable value="structuredBody"/>
        </source>
        <rule>
          <name value="bodyComponent"/>
          <source>
            <context value="structuredBody"/>
            <element value="component"/>
            <variable value="bodyComponent"/>
          </source>
          <rule>
            <name value="section"/>
            <source>
              <context value="bodyComponent"/>
              <element value="section"/>
              <variable value="section"/>
            </source>
            <target>
              <context value="composition"/>
              <contextType value="variable"/>
              <element value="section"/>
              <variable value="compSection"/>
            </target>
            <rule>
              <name value="sectionBase"/>
              <source>
                <context value="section"/>
              </source>
              <dependent>
                <name value="MapCDASectionToCompositionSection"/>
                <variable value="section"/>
                <variable value="compSection"/>
              </dependent>
            </rule>
            <rule>
              <name value="patientSummaryEntries"/>
              <source>
                <context value="section"/>
              </source>
              <dependent>
                <name value="MapPatientSummarySectionEntries"/>
                <variable value="section"/>
                <variable value="compSection"/>
                <variable value="bundle"/>
                <variable value="patient"/>
              </dependent>
            </rule>
          </rule>
        </rule>
      </rule>
    </rule>
  </group>
  <group>
    <name value="MapPatientSummarySectionEntries"/>
    <typeMode value="none"/>
    <documentation
                   value="DISPATCH DES ENTRIES MÉTIER PATIENT SUMMARY
   CDA section.code LOINC -&gt; groupe métier FHIR correspondant"/>
    <input>
      <name value="section"/>
      <mode value="source"/>
    </input>
    <input>
      <name value="compSection"/>
      <mode value="target"/>
    </input>
    <input>
      <name value="bundle"/>
      <type value="Bundle"/>
      <mode value="target"/>
    </input>
    <input>
      <name value="patient"/>
      <type value="Patient"/>
      <mode value="target"/>
    </input>
    <rule>
      <name value="activeProblems"/>
      <source>
        <context value="section"/>
        <element value="code"/>
        <variable value="secCode"/>
        <condition value="secCode.code = '11450-4'"/>
      </source>
      <dependent>
        <name value="PatientSummaryConditionSection"/>
        <variable value="section"/>
        <variable value="compSection"/>
        <variable value="bundle"/>
        <variable value="patient"/>
      </dependent>
    </rule>
    <rule>
      <name value="medicalHistory"/>
      <source>
        <context value="section"/>
        <element value="code"/>
        <variable value="secCode"/>
        <condition value="secCode.code = '11348-0'"/>
      </source>
      <dependent>
        <name value="PatientSummaryConditionSection"/>
        <variable value="section"/>
        <variable value="compSection"/>
        <variable value="bundle"/>
        <variable value="patient"/>
      </dependent>
    </rule>
    <rule>
      <name value="allergies"/>
      <source>
        <context value="section"/>
        <element value="code"/>
        <variable value="secCode"/>
        <condition value="secCode.code = '48765-2'"/>
      </source>
      <dependent>
        <name value="PatientSummaryAllergySection"/>
        <variable value="section"/>
        <variable value="compSection"/>
        <variable value="bundle"/>
        <variable value="patient"/>
      </dependent>
    </rule>
    <rule>
      <name value="medications"/>
      <source>
        <context value="section"/>
        <element value="code"/>
        <variable value="secCode"/>
        <condition value="secCode.code = '10160-0'"/>
      </source>
      <dependent>
        <name value="PatientSummaryMedicationSection"/>
        <variable value="section"/>
        <variable value="compSection"/>
        <variable value="bundle"/>
        <variable value="patient"/>
      </dependent>
    </rule>
    <rule>
      <name value="procedureHistory"/>
      <source>
        <context value="section"/>
        <element value="code"/>
        <variable value="secCode"/>
        <condition value="secCode.code = '47519-4'"/>
      </source>
      <dependent>
        <name value="PatientSummaryProcedureSection"/>
        <variable value="section"/>
        <variable value="compSection"/>
        <variable value="bundle"/>
        <variable value="patient"/>
      </dependent>
    </rule>
    <rule>
      <name value="adverseDrugReactions"/>
      <source>
        <context value="section"/>
        <element value="code"/>
        <variable value="secCode"/>
        <condition value="secCode.code = '44939-7'"/>
      </source>
      <dependent>
        <name value="PatientSummaryAdverseDrugReactionSection"/>
        <variable value="section"/>
        <variable value="compSection"/>
        <variable value="bundle"/>
        <variable value="patient"/>
      </dependent>
    </rule>
    <rule>
      <name value="immunizations"/>
      <source>
        <context value="section"/>
        <element value="code"/>
        <variable value="secCode"/>
        <condition value="secCode.code = '11369-6'"/>
      </source>
      <dependent>
        <name value="PatientSummaryImmunizationSection"/>
        <variable value="section"/>
        <variable value="compSection"/>
        <variable value="bundle"/>
        <variable value="patient"/>
      </dependent>
    </rule>
    <rule>
      <name value="functionalStatus"/>
      <source>
        <context value="section"/>
        <element value="code"/>
        <variable value="secCode"/>
        <condition value="secCode.code = '47420-5'"/>
      </source>
      <dependent>
        <name value="PatientSummaryFunctionalStatusSection"/>
        <variable value="section"/>
        <variable value="compSection"/>
        <variable value="bundle"/>
        <variable value="patient"/>
      </dependent>
    </rule>
    <rule>
      <name value="vitalSigns"/>
      <source>
        <context value="section"/>
        <element value="code"/>
        <variable value="secCode"/>
        <condition value="secCode.code = '8716-3'"/>
      </source>
      <dependent>
        <name value="PatientSummaryVitalSignsSection"/>
        <variable value="section"/>
        <variable value="compSection"/>
        <variable value="bundle"/>
        <variable value="patient"/>
      </dependent>
    </rule>
